raw.title: Senior Platform Engineer
raw.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The opportunity

We are looking for a highly-motivated and driven platform engineer, with experience in enabling a DevOps culture within tech teams. In this role, your primary responsibility will be to provide a world-class developer experience to other engineers. You will have the autonomy to build solutions for the fascinating problems that we have to solve, allowing our customers (the software engineers) to build products quickly, securely, and to a high standard of quality.

What you'll do

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

  • Designing and implementing high quality infrastructure as code templates/modules, and empowering software engineers to use them for their projects.

  • Implementing AWS multi-account core infrastructure, and ensuring security best practices are being used across the cloud estate.

  • Authoring CI/CD templates and optimisations to ensure that engineers can release as early and often as possible.

  • Designing and implementing a developer portal, to provide a service catalog to the engineering team, and also author many other useful DevOps plugins.

  • Contributing to observability best practices and providing key SLI/SLO metric reporting, so that the engineering team can balance velocity and reliability.

  • Develop inner/open source projects to help provide a world-class developer experience to the engineering team.

 

About You

This role will be a great fit if you have:

  • Good working knowledge of AWS services including ECS, EC2, Lambda, VPC, IAM, Route53, CloudFront, S3, RDS

  • Good understanding of monitoring and logging solutions. We use OpenTelemetry, AWS Cloudwatch and SigNoz so experience with them is a bonus.

  • Basic SRE knowledge, and experience in alerting and incident management platforms (eg. incident.io, Pagerduty)

  • Proven ability to provide and support strong and scalable CI/CD pipelines

  • Linux, Git, Docker and good scripting skills in e.g. Python, bash, Go. You should be proficient in at least one modern programming language.

  • Good experience in defining Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.

  • Knowledgeable and comfortable with Agile development practices

  • Great appetite for learning and self-improvement

  • A real passion for developer experience, as well as an understanding and enthusiasm for Platform Engineering as a discipline

  • Previous experience in fintech is a bonus

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

Location

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

Don’t meet every single requirement? At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can flourish, reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognise diverse teams allow a more creative and productive environment. So, if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for - for this role, or perhaps another.

raw.title: Senior Communications & PR Lead (12-month FTC)
raw.description:
How you’ll fix communication in healthcare as a Senior Communications & PR Lead (12m FTC)

At Accurx, we’ve supported thousands of healthcare organisations to deliver care for over 60 million patients. We’re used by 98% of GP practices and in 68% of NHS Trusts - that’s over 200,000 NHS staff each week.

As the Senior Communications & PR Lead at Accurx (12m FTC), you’ll drive brand awareness and interest through top of funnel content to shape Accurx’s reputation across the care settings we operate in and amongst our key audiences of NHS senior decision-makers and policymakers, with a particular focus on secondary care (acute and community & mental health hospitals).

Reporting into the Head of Marketing, you’ll act as a communications expert within the business, providing advice and guidance to senior leaders and GTM teams about strategies and approaches that will help move us towards achieving our company goals, and executing on these.

This is a full-time 12 month fixed term contract, ideally starting from December 2026.

Your day to day tasks, should you choose to accept this mission…

  • Leading day-to-day PR: Working closely with our PR agency, you’ll draft press materials for key moments, secure media coverage and prepare spokespeople to ensure Accurx is consistently positioned as a thought-leader and news moments are maximised. You’ll manage crisis communications, handling media enquiries and drafting social media statements when needed. You’ll use data to measure PR effectiveness, and iterate on your strategy aligned with company goals.

  • Owning the Accurx Unprescribed podcast: You’ll own the production of the Accurx podcast, working directly with Accurx’s CEO (the host) and our freelance producer and videographer. You’ll source and book guests, create briefs for video content, write thought-leadership, website and social media content, and launch episodes. You’ll ensure podcast content supports company and communications objectives, aligns with brand messaging, and reaches key audiences effectively.

  • Running a thought-leadership & brand content programme: You’ll identify opportunities to create high-quality thought-leadership content, such as LinkedIn newsletter pieces, opinion pieces, reports and content for speaking opportunities, working closely with thought-leaders. You’ll own brand content, including Accurx’s brand narrative and other assets like brand videos.

  • Owning Accurx’s LinkedIn channel: You’ll create and optimise LinkedIn content that resonates highly with target audiences and drives engagement. You’ll educate and empower internal teams - particularly sales and leadership - to engage with and share LinkedIn content, helping to expand reach and influence. You’ll monitor LinkedIn performance and adjust content strategies to maximise visibility, engagement, and impact.

We’d really like to hear from you, if you have…

  • PR & communications expertise: Proven experience in PR and communications working with clients or in-house in the B2B / SaaS / tech space - ideally within a regulated industry but not essential.

  • Agency experience: Background working in a PR agency and / or managing a PR agency, bringing a strong understanding of media relations and campaign execution, an ability to move things forward at pace and set clear expectations.

  • Delivered impactful campaigns: A strong track record of planning and executing communications campaigns that drive measurable impact.

  • Exceptional writing & messaging skills: Confident, adaptable writer able to translate complex or technical topics into clear, compelling content tailored to different audiences and channels.

  • Media relations skills: Proven success in pitching stories, building strong relationships with journalists, and understanding what makes a media story land.

  • Project leadership & stakeholder management: Skilled at managing end-to-end projects across multiple teams, balancing competing priorities, building relationships and delivering under tight deadlines.

  • Senior stakeholder confidence: Comfortable working with an exec team and senior leaders, offering comms guidance.

  • Creativity & tenacity: Creative thinker who’s detail-oriented and persistent - able to find solutions, chase down information, and bring new ideas to life.

  • AI courage & curiosity: A curious, hands-on user of AI who experiments with new tools to work faster and smarter, from research to content creation. You apply it with sound judgement and a critical eye, and you share what works with others.

  • Rebrand & category positioning: Experience shaping and launching a rebrand or new category positioning externally, turning it into a clear, compelling story that lands with media and the market.

What’s in it for me?

You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to solve healthcare productivity.

  • £85,000 - £100,000 salary

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Flexible working: We are an office first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am - 4pm

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Family matters: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own Chef! Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches will be provided, with the occasional sweet treat!

Want to know more about the company or the hiring process? Check out our Careers page and Candidate hub.

Find us across social media: Medium, LinkedIn, X, Instagram and YouTube.

Accurx is committed to being an inclusive employer and is happy to accommodate adjustments throughout the interview process. All offers are subject to a Basic DBS check and pre-employment screening.

Compensation: £85K – £100K

  • • £85K – £100K

raw.title: Design Engineer
raw.description:
About Aibidia

Aibidia is a fast-growing SaaS company transforming how multinational businesses manage transfer pricing. We're building intelligent, scalable software that simplifies complex tax and compliance processes, helping some of the world's largest organisations work more efficiently and confidently.

We're a team that values curiosity, ownership and pragmatic problem-solving. As we continue to evolve our products and embrace AI-native ways of working, we're looking for a Design Engineer to help shape the next generation of our platform.

The Role

We're looking for an AI-first Design Engineer who combines strong technical capabilities with a solid understanding of product design, UX and usability.

This is a hybrid role at the intersection of design and engineering. You'll work on complex, data-rich enterprise software, using modern AI tools to rapidly prototype, iterate and deliver intuitive product experiences.

We're not looking for someone who simply creates beautiful interfaces or follows traditional, lengthy design processes. We want someone who thinks systematically, understands how software is built and knows how to leverage AI to turn complex requirements into functional, user-friendly solutions.

You'll join a team that has already established an AI-first design system and modern ways of working. Rather than reinventing what's already in place, you'll build on these foundations, contributing to an evolving design system while helping us move towards faster, more iterative product development.

What You'll Do

Design, prototype and ship

  • Translate complex business requirements and user needs into intuitive, functional product experiences.

  • Rapidly prototype and iterate on new features using AI-powered tools, getting working solutions in front of users early.

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers and domain experts to take ideas from concept through to implementation.

  • Balance usability, technical feasibility and speed of delivery, knowing when to iterate and when a solution is good enough to ship.

  • Design for complex, data-heavy workflows where clarity, efficiency and accuracy matter more than visual embellishment.

Build with an AI-first mindset

  • Use AI tools such as Claude, Figma and MCP integrations as a core part of your design and development workflow.

  • Experiment with emerging AI technologies, agents and workflows to continuously improve how we build products.

  • Apply sound design and engineering judgement to AI-generated outputs, ensuring quality, usability and consistency.

Contribute to our design system

  • Build on and contribute to our existing AI-first design system, ensuring consistency and scalability across the product.

  • Understand and apply design system principles, including components, design tokens, spacing, layouts, accessibility and interaction patterns.

  • Identify opportunities to improve components, documentation and AI-assisted design workflows.

Collaborate and validate

  • Work directly with users and internal stakeholders to understand problems, validate ideas and gather feedback.

  • Take a lean, iterative approach to product development, prioritising early validation over lengthy discovery cycles.

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering to ensure designs are technically achievable and can be efficiently implemented.

  • Continuously refine solutions based on user feedback, technical constraints and evolving business needs.

What We're Looking For

  • A hybrid design and engineering background, with hands-on coding capabilities and a strong understanding of UX, UI and usability principles.

  • Experience using modern AI tools as an integral part of your workflow, with a genuine interest in AI-assisted design, prototyping and development.

  • Strong systems thinking, with an understanding of how scalable design systems, reusable components and technical frameworks work together.

  • Experience contributing to design systems, with knowledge of design tokens, component libraries, accessibility and established UI patterns.

  • Experience working directly with codebases, GitHub and modern frontend technologies, rather than operating solely within traditional design tools.

  • Experience designing or building complex, data-dense B2B SaaS, enterprise or workflow-driven products.

  • Experience working in a startup or scaleup environment, where priorities evolve, teams are lean and speed of execution matters.

  • Strong product judgement and the ability to balance user needs, business requirements and technical constraints.

  • A curious, adaptable mindset and enthusiasm for experimenting with emerging technologies and new ways of working.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, tax technology, compliance or other complex, regulated industries.

  • Exposure to both early-stage startups and larger, more established software organisations.


Why Join Aibidia?

  • Build the future of AI-first product development: Help shape how AI is embedded into the way we design, prototype and ship software.

  • Solve genuinely complex problems: Work on sophisticated enterprise software where thoughtful design and usability have a meaningful impact.

  • Make an impact: Join a lean, collaborative team where your ideas, technical judgement and contributions directly influence the product.

  • Work with modern tools: Experiment with emerging AI technologies and continuously improve how products are built.

  • Grow with us: Be part of a scaling international SaaS business that's challenging traditional approaches to tax technology.

Benefits & Perks:

  • 💰 Share in Aibidia’s success – Enjoy a competitive compensation and incentive package that rewards your contribution.

  • 🏡 Flexible, hybrid working – Flexible working hours and a hybrid policy designed to support how you work best.

  • 🩺 Comprehensive healthcare – A healthcare package to support you and your wellbeing.

  • 💚 Wellbeing that matters – A genuine focus on physical and mental wellbeing, supported by our internal Health & Wellbeing Committee.

  • 🎉 Time to celebrate together – Regular team socials, including our much-loved summer and winter parties.

  • 💻 The best tools for the job – Access to the latest technology to help you do your best work.

  • 🚀 Invest in your growth – Performance-based development is part of our culture, with a dedicated learning budget for every employee.

  • 🌍 Make an impact globally – Join a fast-growing global SaaS company using technology to transform a traditionally complex industry.

  • 🤝 Low hierarchy, high collaboration – Work in an open, collaborative environment where ideas are valued and everyone has the opportunity to make an impact.

 

We are committed to fostering an inclusive culture that celebrates diversity, we want you to bring you, no matter your background, gender, race or sexual orientation!

Please note, we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role. To be considered, you’ll need to show proof of your eligibility to work in the country.

raw.title: EA to Executive Team
raw.description:
Overview

The Executive Assistant is a highly organised, proactive and collaborative partner to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team. Combining high-quality executive support with seamless coordination, this role sits at the heart of the business and offers unique exposure to strategic decision-making across a fast-growing, international company. You’ll bring structure to a fast-moving environment, balancing effective forward planning with practical, methodical and hands-on execution. Beyond day-to-day support, you’ll have the opportunity to improve executive processes, coordinate high-impact company initiatives and help the leadership team operate at its best.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Partnership

  • Partner closely with the CEO to manage priorities, schedules, and day-to-day operations.

  • Own the CEO's calendar and travel, resolving diary conflicts against agreed priorities.

  • Prepare agendas, presentations, briefing documents, and meeting materials.

  • Communicate and work with external parties, including customers, the company board, and potential future investors.

Executive Operations

  • Coordinate the operating rhythm of the Executive Leadership Team.

  • Organise leadership meetings, planning sessions, quarterly offsites, and company events.

  • Capture decisions, maintain action logs, and follow up with owners until actions are closed.

  • Review the leadership meeting calendar each quarter and recommend where meetings or reports can be consolidated or dropped.

  • Use AI tools responsibly to improve efficiency, check for accuracy, and advocate for their use to streamline internal processes.

Company Operations

  • Work with the CFO and relevant parties to own the companywide communications for Goals, including clear updates, robust practices and effective measurement and reporting.

  • Support the CRO in establishing and maintaining an effective operating cadence, including coordinating GTM leadership meetings, cross-functional sessions and team events.

  • Partner with the People Team to deliver key projects and initiatives that contribute to the company’s success, including supporting company-wide meetings and All Hands.

  • Use company knowledge to identify risks, dependencies, and blockers, escalating where appropriate.

Key Competency Behaviours & Ways of Working

Impact & Ownership - delivers high-impact work and takes accountability for outcomes

  • Ownership and follow-through: takes end-to-end accountability for outcomes rather than tasks, closing loops without needing to be chased.

  • Executive judgement: prioritises well on the CEO's behalf on day-to-day matters, and knows what to handle independently and what to escalate.

  • Anticipates rather than reacts: surfaces decisions, risks, and dependencies before they become urgent.

  • Delivers to deadline: flags slippage early rather than absorbing it silently.

Growth & Innovation - brings game-changing solutions that drive growth

  • Continuous improvement: actively simplifies processes and adopts better tooling, including AI, to increase leadership leverage.

  • Commercial awareness: understands the business model and company priorities well enough to sequence competing demands sensibly and flag when something important is at risk.

  • Structure in ambiguity: turns vague requests into clear plans, checklists and timelines for the work they are coordinating.

Team & Collaboration - works effectively and constructively toward collective goals

  • Influence without authority: secures commitment from senior stakeholders and follows up on outstanding actions without relying on positional authority.

  • Communicates concisely and in writing, leading with a recommendation rather than an open question.

  • Manages upwards with confidence, raising issues and blockers directly with senior leaders.

  • Discretion and trust: handles sensitive information and difficult conversations with complete confidentiality.

What Success Looks Like

  • Schedules are planned in advance, with conflicts resolved proactively and without requiring their involvement.

  • Leadership meetings are supported by clear agendas circulated in advance, with actions assigned, documented and completed by agreed deadlines.

  • Project progress, ownership and risks are kept up to date and readily visible to the Leadership Team.

  • Company events and All Hands meetings are delivered smoothly, on time and within budget.

  • At least one executive or company-wide process is measurably improved or simplified each quarter.

Benefits & Perks:

  • 💰 Share in Aibidia’s success – Enjoy a competitive compensation and incentive package that rewards your contribution.

  • 🏡 Flexible, hybrid working – Flexible working hours and a hybrid policy designed to support how you work best.

  • 🩺 Comprehensive healthcare – A healthcare package to support you and your wellbeing.

  • 💚 Wellbeing that matters – A genuine focus on physical and mental wellbeing, supported by our internal Health & Wellbeing Committee.

  • 🎉 Time to celebrate together – Regular team socials, including our much-loved summer and winter parties.

  • 💻 The best tools for the job – Access to the latest technology to help you do your best work.

  • 🚀 Invest in your growth – Performance-based development is part of our culture, with a dedicated learning budget for every employee.

raw.title: Senior ALM Manager
raw.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

The Finance & Treasury function covers a broad spectrum of financial responsibilities for the Bank.

Under the leadership of the CFO and the finance department heads, the team is responsible for equity raising and investor relations; treasury and liquidity management; prudential risk and regulatory reporting; financial reporting and accounting, financial planning, and tax management activities.

We believe that freedom, autonomy, and trust bring the best out of people, so we work with team players who get the importance of owning their responsibilities but know the value of collaboration. We are curious, honest, and supportive.

Role Description

The Senior ALM Manager will be responsible for managing the bank’s balance sheet risks, with a particular focus on interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB), and market risk.

The role involves developing strategies to optimise hedging, while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and internal risk appetite.

The Senior ALM Manager will also play a key role in supporting ALCO decision-making by providing analysis, reporting, and recommendations.

Principal Accountabilities

Balance Sheet Management:

  • Monitor, measure, and manage structural risks in the balance sheet, including liquidity, funding, and IRRBB.

  • Develop and maintain structural hedging strategies.

  • Optimise asset-liability mismatches to support sustainable growth.

  • Interest Rate Risk:

  • Analyse repricing gaps and sensitivity of Net Interest Income (NII) and Economic Value of Equity (EVE).

  • Propose hedging strategies (derivatives, swaps, etc.) to manage structural interest rate exposures.

  • Ensure modelling assumptions (e.g., deposit behaviour, prepayment rates) remain robust and up to date.

Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP)

  • Support the design and maintenance of the FTP framework.

  • Provide recommendations to business lines on pricing and profitability.

Reporting & Governance

  • Produce regular ALM dashboards and reports for ALCO, Risk committees and regulators.

  • Present findings and recommendations to senior management.

  • Ensure compliance with PRA, BoE, and Basel regulatory requirements.

Collaboration

  • Work closely with Treasury, Finance, Risk, and business lines to

  • Ensure alignment of strategies.

  • Contribute to stress testing, ICAAP, ILAAP, and Recovery & Resolution planning.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Strong understanding of balance sheet management, liquidity risk, IRRBB, and capital management.

  • Solid knowledge of PRA/BoE regulatory requirements (LCR, NSFR, IRRBB, ICAAP, ILAAP).

  • Experience with ALM modelling systems (e.g., QRM, Empyrean, Kamakura, Prometeia).

  • Analytical mindset with strong quantitative and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to senior stakeholders.

  • Strong organisational and project management skills.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or related discipline (Master’s preferred).

  • Professional qualifications (e.g., CFA, ACT, FRM, BTRM) are highly desirable.

  • Vast experience in Treasury, ALM, Risk, or related areas within banking.

  • Demonstrated track record of managing balance sheet risks in a regulated environment

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

GTM Strategy & Operations
raw.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

 Benchling is looking for a GTM Strategy & Operations lead to drive high-impact global initiatives, while providing in-region operational and analytical leadership and support for EMEA. Reporting to the Head of RevOps and partnering directly with sales leadership, you'll own the operating cadence that keeps the business running — from annual planning and capacity modeling to forecasting, pipeline health, and quarterly business reviews. You'll also shape how AI gets applied across the GTM org, identifying high-impact use cases and driving adoption. This is a highly cross-functional role: you'll work closely with Marketing, Strategic Finance, Sales Enablement, Deal Desk, and Business Intelligence to turn data into decisions. We're looking for someone who thrives on ambiguity, is comfortable owning a full operating rhythm end to end, and wants to have a direct hand in how Benchling scales its go-to-market motion

RESPONSIBILITIES

 Report directly to the Head of RevOps and partner closely with sales leadership on planning, prioritization, and execution

  • Lead Sales Operations for the EMEA region, from owning annual planning to running the day-to-day operating cadence

  • Build sales capacity, coverage, and quota models that align hiring plans with revenue targets

  • Size and segment the addressable market to inform territory design, whitespace analysis, and account prioritization; design and maintain territory planning

  • Drive the sales forecasting methodology, delivering a defensible quarterly view and improving accuracy over time

  • Own weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls, and quarterly business reviews using data-driven insights to flag risks early and drive proactive decisions

  • Help drive the analytical rhythm of the business by owning performance reporting and analyzing data to generate meaningful insights and recommendations

  • Proactively drive operational efficiency and team productivity by continuously improving processes, tools, and reporting

  • Shape the GTM AI roadmap, from defining high-impact use cases, building or buying the right solutions, and ensuring successful adoption of new capabilities

  • Partner with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Strategic Finance, Sales Enablement, Deal Desk, Technology & Systems, Business Intelligence, etc.

  • Drive various high priority cross-functional initiatives from ideation and planning, through execution

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years in Sales Strategy & Operations, Revenue Operations, or related analytical/GTM roles,

  • A builder mentality, with a track record of repeatable and scalable systems and processes.

  • A self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and brings structured thinking to solve problems and drive results.

  • Advanced analytical skills with the judgment to turn data into a clear recommendation

  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with teams like Finance, Marketing, Enablement, and Product to drive shared initiatives

  • Excited by applying AI/automation to GTM workflows, with a bias toward pragmatic, high-impact use cases over novelty

  • Excellent written and verbal communicator who can flex between detailed analysis and executive-level narrative 

Benchling welcomes everyone.

We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences.

We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

The Head of Professional Services, EMEA is responsible for the growth and excellence of the professional services team in Europe.     • Provide accurate capacity and revenue forecasting to leadership

    • Build trusted relationships with technical and scientific stakeholders at customer organizations

    • Champion the adoption of AI delivery practices within the PS team and with customers

ROLE OVERVIEW

Benchling Solution Consultants (SC) are the primary solution leads with Benchling’s largest customers and prospects. Their solutions are deployed into complex enterprise IT environments, interfacing with other vendor solutions, lab instruments, and legacy applications. This is a highly visible role that partners with both external and internal teams to develop the optimal solutions that drive the most value for our customers. The SC is a pre-sales role, and as such works closely with Benchling sales leadership, account executives, professional services, and product leaders to ensure the best solutions are presented. SCs work with senior scientific and IT leaders from prospects and customers, to establish credibility and confidence from the first meeting, and to create solutions based on cutting-edge technologies.

The SC must be comfortable with Life Sciences R&D processes and scientific concepts, have experience with enterprise SaaS solutions, and be adept at working with internal and external leaders and stakeholders. You must work as a trusted adviser to translate customer objectives into detailed solutions and effectively communicate and demonstrate those solutions to prospects and customers.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Effectively partner with account executives, SC peers, and leadership to create account and deal strategies that lead to selection, planning out customer engagements that lead to compelling solutions.

  • Manage organized discoveries to uncover customer needs and requirements that relate to decision criteria and key business issues.

  • Craft solutions based on Benchling capabilities, industry best practices and standard R&D functions, with data models and processes that map to the customer or prospects' science and that fit into their current technology landscape.

  • Present and demonstrate the solution in a persuasive way based on key messages, decision criteria, and key business issues. Manage customer questions and objections and resolve concerns. Ensure that the solution is presented competitively, with awareness of alternatives including build in house.

  • Engage with product management to provide insight into prospect and customer needs and industry trends. Influence the roadmap for market success. Ensure that the roadmap is clear to customers as required to influence buying decisions.

  • Provide leadership by creating reusable solutions, content, and trainings for key areas. Work with the extended team to ensure that they are successful and learn from your expertise. Mentor and partner with other SCs to build their success.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s in Biology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Biochemistry, Chemistry or similar Life Science field, with a minimum of 4 years of work experience, ideally customer facing.

  • Experience with scientific/informatics software such as LIMS, ELN, or others preferred. Familiarity with antibody engineering software is a plus.

  • Experience in demonstrating scientific software in a pre-sales setting to top 20 biotech and pharma companies is highly desired.

  • Demonstrated capacity to effectively model scientific data, and craft solutions, based on product knowledge and industry best practices. Prior experience in demonstrating and supporting research instruments, reagents or software desired.

  • Understand research technology generally adopted by biopharma companies.

  • Have an agile and adaptable mentality, and can quickly implement new customer engagement processes.

  • Ability to establish as a trusted advisor for scientists, and successfully pitch to scientific buyers.

  • Must be fluent in English. Fluency in German or French is a plus.

raw.title: Account Management Team Lead
raw.description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

Carwow is hiring an Account Management Team Lead to join our Get Your Car (New Market) Partner Success team, focused on car buying. This is a player-coach role with your time split roughly 50/50. Half of it goes on leading and coaching a team of 3 Account Managers, and half on managing your own portfolio of dealer groups. You'll report into the Franchise Account Management Manager and be measured on hitting revenue and retention targets across both your team and your own portfolio.

This role is based in our London office three days a week, with travel to dealer partners as needed.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Leading the team:

  • Coach and develop a team of 3 Account Managers through daily coaching, weekly 1-1s, call shadowing and regular feedback, helping each of them hit their targets and grow in their careers.

  • Support your team with their day-to-day activity. Help them prioritise, prepare for key dealer conversations and work through challenges as they come up.

  • Take ownership of your team's revenue and retention performance. Spot risks early and step in where accounts need support.

  • Act as the first escalation point for your team on complex dealer challenges, commercial conversations and at-risk accounts.

  • Help onboard new Account Managers so they quickly become confident experts on our product and their brands.

Managing your own portfolio:

  • Own a portfolio of dealer groups, becoming an expert on their brands, challenges, opportunities and performance on the Carwow platform.

  • Build strong, long-lasting relationships through proactive communication by phone and video, and get on the road to visit dealers in person when needed.

  • Turn performance data into compelling presentations and a clear story that shows dealers the value of Carwow and brings them on the Carwow journey.

  • Drive revenue and retention in your portfolio, including upselling additional products and services.

Managing your own portfolio:

  • Find and build more efficient ways of working across the team, including smarter use of data, automation and AI tools.

  • Work closely with our Marketplace, OEM and Partner Operations teams, and our field-based Account Management team, so that partner strategies are executed seamlessly.

  • Share insight from your team's dealer conversations to help shape our marketplace, product and commercial decisions.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essential

  • Experience working in a marketplace business and a strong understanding of how two-sided marketplaces work, including supply, demand and the levers that drive partner performance.

  • Proven experience in account management or partner success, with a track record of hitting revenue and retention targets.

  • Strong data skills. You're comfortable analysing performance in Excel or Google Sheets and using it to coach your team and guide partner conversations.

  • The ability to build clear, persuasive slide decks and tell a compelling, data-led story to dealer partners.

  • Confidence using AI tools in your day-to-day work, and curiosity about how technology and automation can help the team work smarter.

  • Excellent communication skills and confidence handling senior stakeholders, both internally and with external dealer partners.

  • The ability to balance your own portfolio with leading a team. You know when to step in and when to empower others to take ownership.

  • A consultative and creative problem solver who understands each client's business and offers tailored solutions.

  • Self-motivated, proactive and results-driven, with the ability to ruthlessly prioritise the highest-impact work.

  • A collaborative team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and adapts quickly to changing priorities.

  • Willingness to travel to visit dealer partners in person when needed.

Nice to have

  • People management experience, or experience coaching and mentoring colleagues.

  • Automotive or dealer group experience.

  • Familiarity with digital marketing.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working

  • Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Vitality Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

    • 28 days annual leave

    • 1 day for your wedding

    • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

    • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

    • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

    • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • Work from abroad for a month

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, so all our applicants are treated fairly and equally.

THE ROLE

This is a director role running the operating engine behind our commercial teams. Carwow sells cars in two ways: Sell My Car, where drivers sell their car to dealers, and Get Your Car, where they buy or lease their next one. As Director, GTM & Revenue Operations you own the operating model those commercial teams run on: the go-to-market process, the enablement and quality that get people productive, the systems they work in (Salesforce and the wider commercial tech stack), the analytics that forecast the commercial number, and the programme management that lands cross-functional change. The function covers five areas: GTM Operations, Sales Enablement, Tooling & Platform, Rev-Ops Analytics and Program Management. You report to the VP, Marketplace Operations and sit close to both the numbers and the commercial teams you serve. You make the commercial motion work; the commercial teams own the selling and the relationships.

This is a builder's role as much as a running one. You inherit a team of three (programme management, sales enablement and platform) and a clear mandate to grow the function to what the business needs. Shaping and hiring that team, and making the case for it, is central to the job. The commercial org has recently brought its Sell My Car and Get Your Car teams into a single account-management function serving one dealer network, so you'll run one operating model across both products (a unified Salesforce, aligned targets and comp, consistent enablement and quality) and get the last of that integration to steady state. The function has already moved real numbers here, reworking the sales process, standing up sales-engagement tooling and sharpening enablement, and your job is to take that further.

You own the operating model, process, enablement, the systems requirement and the forecast. The commercial organisation owns the relationships, the selling and delivery against the number. You design the targets, compensation and territory structures with commercial leadership and you shape decisions through the strength of the operating case. In your first year, success looks like a forecast that's trusted and accurate, new hires productive faster, a consistent quality bar across the combined team, and the platform and process the org runs on every day.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

You will own the commercial operating model and the team that runs it, working hand in glove with the commercial organisation, Workforce Management, the trading leads, and the analytics and data teams that support the whole function.

  • Own GTM operations: define the go-to-market playbook, pipeline and commercial process across both marketplaces, and, with commercial leadership, design the targets, compensation and territory / account structures that tie individual attainment to the business outcome. Own capacity and headcount planning with Workforce Management.

  • Own sales enablement and quality: build the onboarding and ramp-to-productivity structures, a standard readiness sign-off, org-wide QA and calibration, and ongoing L&D for both individual contributors and leaders, so new hires get productive faster and quality holds across the organisation.

  • Own the requirements for the commercial systems and tooling: direct Salesforce as the commercial system of record, owning the process and workflow design, prioritisation and the roadmap to bring the whole commercial org onto one platform, plus the sales-engagement and automation tooling (e.g. Groove), AI-assisted workflows and the performance dashboards the teams run on. You own the requirement and how the commercial org runs on the platform; the platform itself, its build and administration, sits with the tech org, who you partner with and direct.

  • Own revenue-operations analytics and forecasting: produce a forward-looking commercial forecast that feeds trading and reconciles to Finance's P&L view, own the operational reporting that diagnoses what the volume and operational teams are driving into the number, and provide the evidence base behind comp and performance decisions. You own the operational read and set the requirement; you partner with Finance and the central analytics and data teams, who own the build.

  • Own program management: run the commercial PMO, from end-to-end discovery and sizing of new initiatives through governance (charters, RACI, risk and impact), so cross-functional commercial programmes land on time with clear ownership.

  • Build the function: shape and hire the team the function needs across the five areas, from a starting base of three, and make the case for the investment. Run the combined Sell My Car and Get Your Car commercial operation as one, a single dealer view, one operating model, and consistent process across both products.

  • Get more out of the team with AI and automation: mature how the commercial org operates with AI-first tooling and automation, so manual workflows disappear and the org gets the answer without a person in the loop.

  • Feed the operating rhythm: own the commercial-motion input into the weekly operating cadence and the read up to Finance, trading and the CEO, with a clean, leadership-ready view of where the pipeline sits and where it is heading.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

Please note: We know that no candidate will be a perfect match for everything here, so please apply if you're close to the brief. If you meet most of the essentials, we'd like to hear from you.

The essentials:

  • A track record of leading a revenue-operations, commercial-operations or GTM-operations function at scale, in a marketplace, growth or B2B sales context

  • Breadth across the operating model: you've owned, or closely partnered on, most of GTM process, enablement, commercial systems and analytics, and you understand how they fit together

  • Strong CRM fluency with Salesforce as a system of record: you can set the requirements, shape the data model and process, and direct a platform team, not just keep it clean

  • Commercial process and incentive design: targets, compensation, territory and capacity planning tied to business outcomes

How you'll work (we'll explore these in interview):

Nice to have:

YOUR MISSION

Our people are at the heart of everything we do, and the People Operations team is the engine that keeps their experience running smoothly. We’re looking for a support in an upcoming German project for the next 6-12 monts. As our People Operations Executive for Germany, you'll own the accurate, on-time running of our monthly German payroll and be the trusted first point of contact for our German employees' questions on pay, benefits, and everything across the employee lifecycle.

This is a hands-on, detail-driven role for someone who takes real pride in getting things right, thrives in a fast-moving environment, and genuinely enjoys making colleagues feel looked after. You're fluent in German and English, bring hands-on experience of German payroll and employment regulations, and are comfortable handling administrative tasks as part of your responsibilities. You'll be the person who turns it into something reliable, organised, and even better than you found it, using AI and smart tooling to work faster and smarter.

This is a great opportunity to build your career in People Operations: you'll take ownership of the day-to-day running of German payroll and the employee lifecycle for Germany, with support and guidance from the wider People Operations team as you grow into a more senior, more autonomous role.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Payroll:

  • Own the end-to-end processing of our monthly German payroll accurately and on time, from gathering inputs (new starters, leavers, changes, bonuses/commission, absence) through to submission and reconciliation)

  • Act as the point of contact for our German payroll provider, resolving queries and making sure everything ties out each cycle.

  • Ensure payroll compliance with German payroll and employment legislation (income tax, social security contributions, and other statutory requirements) and keep on top of regulatory changes.

  • Maintain meticulous payroll records and support year-end processes and statutory reporting requirements for Germany.

Employee queries & support:

  • Be the friendly, reliable first responder for questions from our German employees on payroll, benefits, and lifecycle matters, resolving them promptly and clearly in German and English so everyone feels supported.

  • Advise employees on people policies and processes, escalating the genuinely complex or sensitive with good judgement and discretion.

  • Spot recurring questions and turn them into self-serve answers, FAQs, and clearer documentation.

Benefits:

  • Administer our benefits programmes for German employees day to day, including enrolments, changes, leavers, and provider liaison.

  • Help employees understand and make the most of what's on offer.

  • Support benefits renewals and improvements, keeping records accurate throughout.

Employee lifecycle:

  • Process joiners, leavers, and employee changes within Germany, and deliver a smooth, engaging experience across the full lifecycle, including onboarding, contractual changes, family leave, and offboarding.

  • Prepare accurate documentation (contracts, letters, changes to terms) in line with German employment regulations, and keep our HRIS (Hibob) clean and up to date at all times.

  • Make sure every touchpoint feels considered, so people have a great experience from day one to their last day.

  • Keep our people data accurate, consistent, and audit-ready. You'll treat data quality as non-negotiable.

  • Produce clear, reliable reports and pull basic insights to support decision-making.

  • Use AI tools and automation to reduce manual effort, speed up admin, and improve accuracy.

  • Suggest and implement improvements to workflows and documentation, leaving things better than you found them.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our award-winning Data Science team at a pivotal moment. Carwow operates a two-sided marketplace — connecting car buyers and sellers at scale — and data science sits at the heart of how we make that marketplace smarter, faster, and more valuable for everyone in it. In fact, we recently won GenAI initiative of the Year at the British Data Awards.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role working centrally across the business. You'll partner with teams spanning Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations — developing and deploying ML and AI solutions that drive outcomes across both sides of our marketplace. The problems you'll work on are genuinely varied: pricing models, propensity and demand signals that sharpen marketing spend, personalised recommendations for our web product and CRM, and LLM-powered solutions for operational challenges like document verification.

You'll translate ambiguous business problems into structured, production-ready solutions — and you'll be expected to deliver them end-to-end, from first principles through to being deployment-ready and beyond.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • End-to-End ML & AI Delivery: Lead data science initiatives from problem framing through to deployment, monitoring, and iteration — delivering the full production lifecycle. With no dedicated ML engineering function, you'll be responsible for ensuring your solutions are robust, scalable, and performing in the real world long after they ship.

  • GenAI & LLM Application: Design and build LLM-powered solutions where they create genuine business value — document processing, intelligent search, content understanding, and beyond. Apply them alongside classical ML with clear judgement about where each approach earns its place.

  • Commercial Impact: Connect your work directly to business outcomes. Whether you're building a model to improve marketing efficiency, a pricing signal to sharpen commercial decisions, or a recommendation engine to increase conversion — you understand the business lever you're pulling and design your solutions accordingly.

  • Prototyping & Experimentation: Move fast to test ideas before committing to full-scale development. Define rigorous success metrics upfront, validate honestly, and know when to double down and when to walk away.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations stakeholders to understand problems deeply before reaching for a solution. Translate findings into clear, actionable narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Standards & Craft: Contribute to shared best practices, documentation, and ways of working that raise the bar for the data science function — and help more junior team members grow alongside you. Drive continued adoption of AI capabilities to drive efficiencies, automation and constantly leverage new capabilities.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

Please note: We know that no candidate will be the perfect match for all we've listed in this posting, so we’d encourage you to apply if you feel you're close to the brief but not an exact match. Ideally you’ll have

  • Commercial Mindset: You think about business impact first. You understand how your models connect to revenue, efficiency, or customer outcomes — and you use that to prioritise, scope, and communicate your work.

  • Stakeholder Partnership: Proven ability to work with commercial, marketing, and product stakeholders — translating business problems into well-scoped solutions and communicating technical solutions, challenges and outcomes clearly at all levels.

  • Sound Judgement: You navigate the tooling landscape with clear eyes — knowing when classical ML is right, when GenAI unlocks something new, and when a simpler solution is the more honest answer. Strong instincts for scalability, reliability, and explainability.

  • [Bonus] Marketplace or Two-Sided Platform Experience: Understanding of supply/demand dynamics and how data science creates leverage in a marketplace context.

TEHCNICAL SKILLSET

  • Proven ML Experience: A strong track record of building, deploying, and maintaining ML models in Python in a production environment — not just notebooks. You've owned models after they ship and know how to keep them healthy.

  • Full-Lifecycle Delivery (MLOps): Comfortable delivering the end-to-end production lifecycle — model training, versioning, monitoring, and champion/challenger experimentation — without relying on a dedicated ML engineering team to carry that responsibility.

  • GenAI & LLM Expertise: Hands-on experience building LLM-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You understand how to apply, evaluate, and extend these tools — and you're honest about where they fall short.

  • Technical Depth: Solid experience in a cloud ML environment with software engineering principles — version control, code reviews, unit testing, and familiarity with containerisation.

  • Quantitative Rigour: Strong foundation in statistical evaluation and experiment design. You can define and defend success metrics, and you know when a model is degrading and what to do about it.

  • [Bonus] Experience with VertexAI

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES

  • Languages: Python, SQL

  • Data & Transformation: dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery

  • Visualisation & BI: Looker

  • Engineering & MLOps: Docker, GitHub

  • Workflow & Orchestration: Vertex AI Pipelines (GCP), Kubeflow

  • LLMs & GenAI: Gemini API, Claude API

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Step 1: People Team Screening Call (30 min)

  • Step 2: Hiring Manager Call: Experience (45 min)

  • Step 3: Technical Task: covering both Modelling & Production with Presentation (60 min + Task)

  • Step 4: Values Interview (45 min)

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working

  • Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Vitality Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

    • 28 days annual leave

    • 1 day for your wedding

    • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

    • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

    • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

    • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • Work from abroad for a month

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

OUR MISSION

In the last couple of years we have gone big and acquired both Carwow Leasey, a leasing broker, and Autovia, creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines, doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach of over 350 million. We also launched our successful Sell My Car business in Germany. We are continually driving to make Carwow the go-to destination for people looking to change their car.

And we’re a long way from done!

LEGAL & COMPLIANCE @ CARWOW

Our fantastic legal team has been compared to a set of high-performance tyres, enabling Carwow to drive and corner at high speeds whilst keeping Carwow firmly on the road in all conditions. As the business pushes forward with bold ambitions, the legal team’s purpose is clear: to drive Carwow’s growth with integrity and confidence – and that’s where you come in!

YOUR MISSION

We are a platform that sits right in the middle between consumers and OEMs/Dealers in the car-changing journey. Datasits at the heart of everything we do and we want to commercialise it responsibly.

As Senior Privacy Counsel, you will be Carwow’s dedicated in-house privacy lawyer and operational privacy lead, playing a pivotal role in enabling the business to grow and scale at pace with integrity. This is an exciting opportunity to develop your career in a complex, high-growth and data-thirsty marketplace business.

We are looking for a Senior Privacy Counsel who wants to do more than provide legal advice from the sidelines. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-performing legal function as our first dedicated in-house privacy hire, taking ownership of the day-to-day privacy programme while acting as a senior legal and strategic advisor to the business as it sharpens its privacy governance programme and steers towards further growth and an exit.

We are not at “Day Zero”. We currently have an external DPO, established policies, templates, a RoPA and a risk register.

We need a tech-fluent privacy lawyer who is equally comfortable advising and doing: someone who can interpret complex legal requirements, exercise sound legal judgement and provide pragmatic advice, but who will also roll up their sleeves and build, operate and continuously improve the mechanisms that make privacy work in practice.

You will have the mandate to lift the lid on our technology stack, validate our data flows, identify legal and operational privacy risks and work directly with our Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing and commercial teams to keep the business safe and moving fast.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Privacy governance and framework development: Own, develop and maintain Carwow’s enterprise privacy governance framework, encompassing internal policies, ROPAs, privacy notices, risk registers, retention schedules and associated controls. Interpret applicable legal requirements and ensure our documentation and processes reflect the reality of Carwow’s technology stack and processing activities, leading remediation where discrepancies or risks are identified.

  • Legal advice and business partnering: Act as Carwow’s principal in-house legal advisor on privacy and data protection matters. Develop strong business partnering relationships across Marketing, Media, Product, Engineering, Data and other parts of the business, providing pragmatic, risk-based legal advice that enables commercial objectives while appropriately managing privacy risk. Provide advice to senior management and support the General Counsel in updating the Company’s Senior Leadership Team and Executives as needed.

  • Culture & Training: Build a strong internal perception of privacy as a “trust builder”. Design and deliver role-specific training that is engaging, commercially relevant and free of unnecessary legal jargon, helping teams understand both their legal obligations and how to apply them in practice.

  • Breach response: Lead the privacy aspects of data breach and incident response, working cross-functionally to investigate incidents, assess legal and regulatory risk, determine notification obligations and oversee remediation. Liaise with the external DPO, regulators and other relevant stakeholders as appropriate.

  • DPAs, DSAs and data contracting: Draft, review and negotiate DPAs, DSAs and other data protection provisions and agreements arising from commercial arrangements. Provide practical legal advice on controller/processor relationships, data sharing, international transfers and related privacy risks.

  • DSARs and individual rights: Own and continuously improve Carwow’s processes for responding to data subject rights requests, ensuring requests can be handled lawfully, efficiently and with minimal disruption to the business. Provide legal guidance on complex or sensitive requests where required.

  • Retail Media and Ad Tech: Provide legal and operational privacy support on new commercial propositions looking to leverage Carwow’s data for third-party audience targeting, segmentation and advertising. Advise on the appropriate use of personal data, profiling, consent and data-sharing structures and help design commercially workable and legally robust mechanisms for using and sharing data.

  • Product, Data and Technology: Work closely with Data & Insights, IT, Engineering and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle to embed Privacy by Design. Lead or support privacy assessments, identify legal and operational risks in new products and processing activities, and translate complex technical data flows into clear, risk-based advice for the General Counsel, Executives and wider business.

  • Operationalise Compliance: Own and operate core privacy compliance processes, including DPIAs, LIAs and data-sharing assessments. Look continuously for opportunities to integrate these into existing business workflows, with an eye on making compliance proportionate, scalable and automated wherever possible.

  • Regulatory developments: Monitor and interpret relevant developments in privacy, data protection, digital regulation and related areas, assess their impact on Carwow and translate new legal requirements into practical changes to products, policies, controls and business processes.

  • Corporate work: Provide privacy legal support on M&A, funding and other corporate transactions, including conducting privacy due diligence, identifying material risks and supporting remediation and integration activity.

  • AI and emerging technology: Advise on the privacy implications of AI and emerging technologies adopted or developed across the business, while supporting the development of practical governance mechanisms that allow Carwow to innovate responsibly.

  • Multi-jurisdictional: Support Carwow’s businesses across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal, advising on relevant local and European privacy requirements and working with external counsel where specialist local advice is required.

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • A qualified lawyer, admitted to practise in England & Wales or another relevant UK or European jurisdiction, with significant experience advising on privacy and data protection matters.

  • Significant experience working in-house, balancing legal and regulatory requirements with commercial objectives and operating as a trusted advisor to the business.

  • Strong working knowledge of UK and European data protection law, with the ability to interpret legislation, regulatory guidance and emerging issues and translate them into clear, practical and commercially workable advice.

  • Experience not only providing privacy legal advice but also building, operating or materially contributing to a privacy programme, including areas such as DPIAs, RoPAs, privacy notices, data rights, retention, incident response and privacy governance.

  • The ability and willingness to work autonomously as Carwow’s principal in-house privacy specialist, moving comfortably between complex legal analysis and hands-on operational delivery.

BONUS POINTS

raw.description:
About Clay

AI is unleashing the biggest wave of company creation in history. Clay's mission is to be the engine those companies use to grow to their full potential.

Clay predicts the next best action for your business and then helps you take it. We started by aggregating the best data for B2B companies. Then, we built the infrastructure to run any personalized campaign on top of it, including emails, ads, landing pages, and workflows that make reps more productive. Now, we're building agents that can help grow your company for you. We're already helping thousands of customers — including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and Visa — go to market with unique data, signals, and AI research.

In 2026, we raised a $115M Series D at $7.1B Valuation led by Wellington — and are on track to cross $200M in revenue this quarter. We also launched a $1M Scholarship fund for GTME Education.

Some things to know about us:

  • Our community includes 17,000+ customers, 200+ integration partners, 125+ agencies, 50+ Clay clubs, and 30k members on Slack.

  • Our culture is unique inside and outside of work. Our team members are also DJs, activists, writers, clowns, marathoners, skydivers, psychedelic therapists, social workers, and more.

  • All employees can work with world-class coaches who specialize in creativity, management, and more.

  • Our operating principles — including negative maintenance and non-attached action — guide our work. Read more about them here.

  • Read about us in the NYT, Forbes, First Round Review, and more.

Hear from our employees directly on our Glassdoor page!

GTM Solutions Engineering @ Clay

The GTM Solutions Engineering team is the technical backbone of enterprise deals, helping customers push the limits of what’s possible with Clay. Whether it’s getting more out of data providers, integrating seamlessly with CRMs, or unlocking new use cases with Claygent, the team makes sure every POC is high-quality, accurate, and built to win. Sitting within the GTM org, Solutions Engineers partner closely with GTM Engineers (GTMEs) to field technical questions, troubleshoot complex challenges, and build creative, high-impact solutions that drive revenue. With Clay shipping new features daily, the team stays ahead — testing, experimenting, and implementing.

Impact You’ll Have

  • Own POCs from start to finish – Deliver high-quality, accurate POCs on time that directly impact enterprise sales cycles.

  • Systems thinker – You'll set up the team to complete POCs 50% faster by templatizing, automating, and scaling best practices.

  • Drive best-in-class solutions – Answer technical questions, build out templates, and push creative solutions.

  • Partner closely with GTM-Engineers - Act as the technical counterpart to sales, ensuring they have the right solutions, data, and infrastructure to close deals.

  • Empower enterprise customers – Help them unlock the full power of Clay by leveraging data providers, CRM integrations, APIs, and Claygent to solve their biggest challenges.

  • Be the voice of the customer – Gather and report feedback to engineering, not just on bugs and feature requests, but on big-picture opportunities to make Clay even better.

What You’ll Bring

  • 4+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Revops, or a technical CX role

  • A track record of systematizing Solutions Engineering work by templatizing, automating, and scaling best practices.

  • Clay experience – You already know Clay well and are comfortable working with Waterfalls, APIs, CRM integrations, Claygent, etc.

  • Excitement about partnering with sales – You thrive on working closely with GTMEs to win enterprise deals

  • Deep understanding of Revops – You know how Clay is used in enterprise sales workflows and can design solutions for real-world use cases

  • Customer-facing experience – You can confidently talk to enterprise customers, translate technical details into business impact, and present solutions clearly

This role is perfect for someone who loves solving complex problems, thrives on close collaboration with sales teams, and gets excited about using Clay to build creative, high-impact solutions. To succeed, you’ll need an impeccable eye for detail, the ability to move fast while prioritizing multiple tickets at once, and a deep understanding of how our customers use Clay.
