raw.title: EMEA | Delivery Lead
raw.description:
About the role

As a Delivery Lead at Infinite Lambda, you'll hold accountability for the successful delivery of multi-workstream programmes for our most important clients. You will own the entire programme lifecycle — from commercial handover through to closure — coordinating multiple projects, teams, and delivery streams into a single coherent outcome. You will be a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, including C-level executives, and the person our clients and our own leadership turn to when a programme hits a serious issue and needs a steady, credible hand to resolve it.

You are a critical partner in our client relationships, working closely with Account Managers to protect and grow long-term accounts, and with Executive Sponsors to keep governance sharp and escalations resolved quickly. Beyond delivery, you're expected to translate ambiguous, high-level business strategy into structured requirements and a deliverable roadmap — bringing the same rigour to business analysis as you do to programme governance.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end delivery of multi-workstream programmes spanning multiple projects, vendors, and delivery teams, using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches tailored to each client and phase.

  • Hold ultimate accountability for programme scope and benefits realisation across the full programme lifecycle.

  • Act as the escalation point for serious programme issues: recover programmes that are off-track, re-baseline commercials and timelines where needed, and manage the client conversations that come with it.

  • Design and enforce programme-level governance models, RAID processes, and reporting standards, ensuring predictable, high-quality execution is visible at every level from delivery team to executive sponsor.

  • Facilitate steering committees, delivering clear, credible updates and recommendations to C-level stakeholders on both the client and Infinite Lambda side.

  • Build and hold relationships with senior client stakeholders and executive sponsors, acting as a trusted voice in high-stakes conversations, difficult trade-offs, and commercial negotiations.

  • Lead business analysis at a programme level: gather and structure high-level business requirements and strategic objectives, and translate them into a coherent programme roadmap, benefits case, and workstream breakdown.

  • Identify and manage cross-workstream dependencies, escalating and closing them out before they threaten delivery.

  • Constructively challenge technical and commercial assumptions across workstreams, guiding recovery plans and trade-off decisions between engineering quality, cost, and delivery speed at a programme level.

  • Own commercial governance for the programme, including Change Control, Change Orders, and milestone sign-off, working closely with Account Managers and Executive Sponsors to protect margin and client trust.

  • Represent Infinite Lambda credibly in the most demanding client conversations — the ones where relationships, not just delivery plans, are on the line.

Requirements

Experience:

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex, multi-workstream programmes, with a strong focus on data warehouse migration and/or AI.

  • Consulting background, ideally within data or technology consultancies.

  • Track record of taking accountability for troubled or at-risk programmes and successfully recovering them — commercially and operationally.

  • Demonstrated business analysis experience at a strategic level — translating executive-level business objectives into structured requirements, benefits cases, and roadmaps.

  • Extensive experience with agile methodologies at programme scale, including managing dependencies and governance across multiple concurrent workstreams.

  • Strong conceptual understanding of software engineering and data delivery principles, sufficient to challenge, guide, and support technical leadership across several workstreams at once.

  • Significant experience in business change as well as IT delivery, at an enterprise or large-account level.

  • Gravitas, credibility, and maturity to engage, influence, and hold difficult conversations with C-level stakeholders on both client and internal sides.

  • Commercial experience: negotiating Change Orders, managing fixed-cost and T&M commercial models, and protecting margin under pressure.

  • Travel requirements for this role are mandated by the need of the client and depending on the client some travel is required.

Skills:

  • Proficiency in a variety of programme and project management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Trello).

  • Strong business analysis toolkit at programme scale: requirements gathering, benefits mapping, process mapping, and senior stakeholder workshops.

  • Exceptional problem-solving, conflict resolution, and change management skills, particularly under pressure or in adversarial situations.

  • Ability to structure a complex, ambiguous programme into a clear workstream breakdown, dependency map, and governance model.

  • Experience managing multiple concurrent programmes or a large single programme with several parallel workstreams.

  • Familiarity with a range of delivery methodologies and the judgement to select and adapt the right one per workstream.

Mindset:

  • Comfortable holding ultimate accountability, including for issues you didn't personally cause.

  • Calm and decisive under pressure — the person the room looks to when a programme is at risk.

  • Demonstrated ability to orchestrate the big picture across multiple workstreams while still tracking the details that matter.

  • A collaborative and positive approach to people, balanced with the willingness to have difficult conversations early.

  • Willingness to take new directions and adapt to changing priorities at short notice.

Nice to have Skills

  • Working knowledge of SQL and data warehousing concepts.

  • Familiarity with data visualisation tools (e.g. Omni, Sigma, Tableau, PowerBI).

  • Formal programme management certification (e.g. MSP, PMI-PgMP) or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Proven experience leading data warehousing and analytics programmes, preferably migrations, at enterprise scale.

Soft skills

  • Servant leadership mindset with the ability to manage, motivate, inspire and support Project Managers and delivery teams.

  • Outstanding communication skills, calibrated for C-level and executive audiences.

  • A considerate, curious, positive, naturally collaborative and supportive approach to people, without shying away from hard conversations.

  • Proactivity regarding risk, issues and planning, especially the risks that haven't surfaced yet.

  • Ability to present complex technical and commercial concepts clearly to non-technical, senior audiences.

  • Natural problem-solving attitude, strong facilitation skills, and sound judgement under ambiguity.

  • Proficiency in English.

Interview Process

  • Take-home technical and case-based assignment.

  • Technical interview with Head of Programme Management: 60 minutes.

  • Cultural interview with Chief of Customer Success

Why join Infinite Lambda

  • We support your growth with dedicated learning time, access to top-notch resources and a knowledge-sharing culture;

  • You work autonomously here in a wholesome environment and get as much paid holiday as you need;

  • The projects are diverse and give you plenty of opportunity to experiment with new tech;

  • The benefits are plenty, with private health insurance, work-from-home budget, a company MacBook and more on the list.

 

▶ ▶ Submit your CV in English in PDF.

▶ ▶ Mind that as we are an international team, internal communication is in English.

Infinite Lambda is an equal opportunity employer. Our inclusive culture celebrates diversity and treats everyone with dignity and respect. Accordingly, our selection process will never discriminate against applicants on the grounds of any characteristics, such as disability, age, gender, sexual orientation, family status, race, faith or other.

raw.title: Senior Publisher Partnerships Manager – Enterprise Non-Gaming
raw.description:
InMobi (Corporate)

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

InMobi Advertising

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

Glance

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

Overview of the role: 

The Enterprise Publisher Partnerships team sits within the broader Supply organization at InMobi and plays a pivotal role in driving strategic growth across our advertising exchange. This team manages direct relationships with media owners across app, web, and CTV environments to maximize monetization through diverse integration methods and high-quality demand. 

Based in London, this is a high-impact, externally facing role focused on expanding InMobi from an app-first exchange to a truly omnichannel platform. You'll be responsible for building and scaling partnerships with premium enterprise publishers, with a particular focus on video and CTV supply. You'll also serve as a key conduit between internal cross-functional teams, including Product, Demand, and Marketplace, and the external publisher ecosystem, ensuring alignment and collaboration that drives results. 

Reporting to the Director, Publisher Partnerships (Non-Gaming), you'll own a book of business across EMEA, manage partner growth strategies, and represent InMobi at industry events, meetings, and forums. This is a unique opportunity to play a central role in InMobi's omnichannel expansion strategy.


The impact you'll make: 

  • Represent and manage a portfolio of high-priority publisher customers, identifying opportunities for growth, managing risks, and creating multi-quarter plans for achievement.
  • Manage a defined book of business within your first 90 days, with clear ownership of strategic publisher accounts.
  • Develop strong customer relationships and a deep understanding of their business(es), strengths, and challenges to identify and drive new opportunities.
  • Meet or exceed revenue targets consistently while prioritizing and delivering outstanding customer experiences.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Demand, and Marketplace teams to coordinate supply and demand strategies and ensure partner success.
  • Strategize monetization for new supply partners, particularly in the CTV space, and work closely with Sales teams to position new opportunities.
  • Facilitate enablement and training between publisher partners and Sales teams to maximize alignment and adoption.
  • Attend key industry events and represent InMobi as a credible ambassador in the market.
  • Develop an understanding of the technical aspects of ad serving and SSP functionality.
  • Coach peers proactively within the organization to uplift team capabilities and contribute to broader success.
  • Generate growth plans by collaborating with Business Development, Marketplace, Product, and Engineering teams—leveraging customer feedback to shape goals and identify strategic opportunities.


The experience we need:

  • A flexible, startup mindset with a strong sense of ownership and a track record of success in fast-paced, high-growth environments
  • Demonstrated ability to build, grow, and sell into customer relationships—preferably with existing accounts
  • Proven success in developing account growth plans, influencing decision-makers, and aligning on shared goals
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to extract insights from data and navigate ambiguity
  • Experience managing multiple priorities with effective process and project management skills
  • Proactive, action-oriented, and comfortable working cross-functionally across time zones and functions
  • Adept at building publisher networks, particularly in the New York market, and engaging with partners in person at industry events
  • Familiarity with advertising technology and monetization platforms, and a readiness to quickly master new systems and market trends
  • Collaborative team player with strong interpersonal skills, leadership instincts, and a sense of humor

What we build… 

At InMobi, we're building products that are redefining industries. Our ecosystem spans:  

  • InMobi Advertising – Powering data-driven mobile marketing for the world's leading brands 
  • Glance – A revolutionary Gen AI-powered lockscreen & TV content platform transforming how millions discover and engage with content
  • 1Weather – One of the world's leading weather platforms, delivering precise, reliable, and real-time weather forecasts 

With deep expertise in AI, mobile, consumer technology, and digital innovation, we are home to some of the brightest minds in the industry.  

What sets us apart? 

Not just what we build. How we build it. At InMobi, we balance our hunger for cutting-edge tech with a deep focus on our people - their growth, well-being, and potential. 

At InMobi, you'll be surrounded by people who… 

  • Think big and act fast: We're entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
  • Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work: We care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
  • Own their outcomes: We take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
  • Embrace freedom with accountability: We value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
  • Believe in lifelong learning: We welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren't afraid to take smart risks  

Award-winning culture, best-in-class benefits  

Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay parity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location. 

An InMobian may also receive variable pay in the form of an annual variable bonus or quarterly variable bonus/sales incentive, as deemed per policy, in addition to fixed compensation.

In addition to cash compensation, based on the position, an InMobian can receive equity. We believe that our employees/personnel should have the ability to own a part of the entity they are a part of. Therefore, the entity employing you may elect to provide such stocks to you. Ownership of stock enables us to treat our employer company as our own and base our decisions on the company's best interests at heart. To encourage a spirit of shared ownership, we grant InMobians relevant company stock(s). As you contribute to the growth of your company, certain stocks may be issued to you in recognition of your contribution.  

A quick snapshot of our benefits: 

  • Competitive salary and ESOP grant (where applicable)        
  • High-quality medical and dental insurance 
  • Generous combination of vacation time, sick days, special occasion time, and company-wide holidays   
  • Substantial maternity and paternity leave benefits and compassionate work environment 
  • Flexible working hours to suit everyone 
  • Wellness stipend for a healthier you!      
  • Free lunch provided in our offices daily   
  • Pet-friendly work environment and robust pet insurance policy - because we love our animals! 
  • LinkedIn Learning on demand for personal and professional development
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)    

If this sounds like the kind of team, role, values, benefits, and challenges that excite you, we'd love to hear from you. 

InMobi is an equal opportunity employer      

InMobi is a place where everyone can grow. Howsoever you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this sounds like a role that would make you excited to work.  

InMobi provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.  

The InMobi Culture

At InMobi, culture isn't a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.

We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.

We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.

InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.

Visit https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers to better understand our benefits, values, and more!

raw.title: Data Scientist - Broker Flow
raw.description:
Data Scientist - Broker Flow Team

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Broker Flow team.

You'll own the experiments that shape the journey brokers use to apply on their clients' behalf. Brokers are one of iwoca's main routes to new customers.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Broker Flow, a new team in iwoca's third-party acquisition department, owns the journey for businesses that come to iwoca through a broker – from before they apply to a completed credit assessment. Its aim is to get more of those businesses to an offer. Broker Terms, a separate team, then sets the price, amount, and duration of each offer.

The team works on three parts of that journey:

  • Broker engagement. Working with brokers and their clients before an application starts.

  • The application. Making it smooth to complete, and collecting the data a credit decision needs.

  • Operations. Running the CRM tools iwoca's teams work in, and automating operational processes.

The team is small and cross-functional – commercial strategy, engineering, design, and data science – and works across the full application stack, from the Broker API to the Introducer Portal brokers use.

The role

As the Data Scientist in Broker Flow, you'll give the team the evidence behind its product decisions. The core of the work is experiment design and causal inference, with modelling and analysis alongside it.

You'll own each project end to end. You'll frame the problem, choose the method, build the model or run the test, and take the answer to the commercial and strategy colleagues who act on it. You'll also meet brokers in person, which gives you the context to ask the right questions. The team is new, so its methods are yours to shape. You'll see the effect of your work in how many businesses reach an offer, and in their lifetime value.

You'll work with data scientists in iwoca's other broker and partner teams, and join the analytics guild – iwoca's data science community – to compare methods and build your expertise. Your results reach the wider business through Learnings, short write-ups that iwoca shares at weekly and fortnightly sessions.

Live project examples:

  • Refinancing. Modelling which businesses would benefit from refinancing their existing borrowing, and testing a product for them.

  • Stalled applications. Finding where broker applications stall, and testing fixes – from clearer emails and portal updates to an early offer that encourages document upload.

  • Reintroductions. Testing the best moment for brokers to bring existing iwoca customers back to borrow.

  • Approval probability. Measuring how well the estimate brokers see in the Introducer Portal predicts actual credit decisions, and making it more accurate.

  • Measuring impact. Designing early signals – at sign-up and once documents are in – that predict a business's lifetime value, so the team can judge its changes quickly.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field such as mathematics, physics, or statistics. You're comfortable with Bayesian reasoning, and have applied hierarchical models or formal decision-making under uncertainty in real work.

  • Causal inference and experimentation. You've separated signal from noise in observational and experimental data. You know where A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead.

  • Analytical ownership. You take loosely defined problems from start to finish – framing the question, choosing the method, and landing the answer with the people who act on it.

  • Data tooling. You're proficient with data manipulation and modelling tools, and with scientific computing libraries.

  • AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – an analysis pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't, and you check its output before anyone acts on it.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in commercial and strategy roles.

Bonus:

  • Modelling depth. You've built or adapted statistical or ML models and can explain the maths behind them.

  • Stochastic methods. You've used stochastic processes for inference or time-series modelling.

  • Broker market insight. You've worked with brokers or other intermediaries in lending or financial services.

  • Coding. You can write code for analysis. The team works in Python.

The salary

We expect to pay from £70,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

raw.description:
About Juicebox

Juicebox is on a mission to help teams win the talent war.

In the age of AI, human ingenuity is the ultimate scarce resource. Recruiting is a zero-sum game where you either compete or lose.

Teams at Ramp, Notion, and leading AI labs use Juicebox to power their hiring, alongside 5,000+ customers from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 companies.

We are on the path to $100M in ARR with 20%+ monthly growth, powering thousands of searches every day and making Juicebox one of the fastest-growing AI SaaS companies in the world.

Juicebox has raised over $116M in funding from lead investors including Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and NFDG. Read more about our $80M Series B here. Additional investors in Juicebox include Y Combinator, Coatue, Bond, Lux, Verified Capital, and Committed Capital.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Community & Events Lead to bring the Juicebox brand to life as we expand into London and broader EMEA. You’ll build relationships with recruiters, talent leaders, VCs, and founders through high-impact events, content, and creative programming.

From sourcing dinners to tactical roundtables to conference strategy, you’ll own our community roadmap and help position Juicebox as the most trusted voice in recruiting + AI.

This is a high-visibility, high-creativity role that sits at the intersection of marketing, customer success, and brand. You’ll be the face of the brand – building relationships with some of the best talent teams and amplifying their stories.

You Will…

  • Plan and execute in-person events (dinners, happy hours, panels, field marketing, offsites)

  • Partner with our Community Lead to curate and build a customer community in London and across EMEA

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to identify customer champions and storytelling opportunities

  • Coordinate logistics, vendors, comms, and promotion for each event

  • Create repeatable playbooks for event and community engagement

  • Track success metrics across engagement, retention, and brand reach

You Have…

  • Have 3+ years experience in community, events, field marketing, or brand, with previous SaaS experience

  • Are an exceptional communicator – warm, articulate, and detail-obsessed

  • Have experience organizing high-quality B2B conferences and events (bonus if with talent or GTM audiences

  • Know how to build systems from scratch and aren’t afraid to get scrappy

Bonus Points If You…

  • Familiar with recruiting, HR tech, or B2B SaaS

  • Experience building executive-level or industry communities

  • A strong creative eye and/or content instincts

  • Prior experience working directly with founders or early-stage teams

Perks & Benefits for Full Time Employees

  • Top-of-market compensation with meaningful equity, because everyone should share in our success.

  • Comprehensive healthcare with 100% employer-paid medical coverage for employees (PPO Platinum plan with $0 deductible). 90% employer contribution for dependents. Dental & Vision: 90% employer covered; 85% for dependents.

  • $2,000 annual wellness stipend to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being.

  • Daily meals provided: breakfast catering, lunch order via DoorDash corporate, and for those who like to work late, dinner if staying after 7pm

  • $300/month commuting stipend to help cover the cost of getting to and from the office.

raw.description:
About Keyrock

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

 

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Head of Marketing to take full ownership of our marketing strategy, rebrand Keyrock and reposition us as the market evolves from crypto-native to institutional, merging with traditional finance.

This is not a maintenance role. It is a transformation mandate with full discretionary decision-making on how to implement our commercial strategy. You will work as a close strategic partner to the CCO, operating almost as co-marketeers.

The team is lean by design: 2-3 direct reports plus heavy use of AI and agentic tooling. We are looking for someone who inspires and sets direction, not someone who runs campaigns. Operational execution will increasingly be handled by AI agents.

What You Will Do

  • Own and execute the complete rebrand and repositioning of Keyrock in the market

  • Define and drive the marketing strategy across institutional and crypto-native audiences

  • Build a premium, forward-looking brand identity. Think distinctive, audacious, credible to both institutional allocators and crypto-native operators

  • Push information into the market in ways that make people pay attention and take Keyrock seriously

  • Partner closely with the CCO and commercial team to drive measurable commercial impact

  • Build and lead a small, high-impact team augmented by AI tooling

  • Shape how Keyrock is perceived as the industry converges with traditional finance

Who You Are

  • Crypto-native. You have been through market cycles. You understand blockchain technology deeply but you are pragmatic, not ideological. You know this is not a binary world.

  • A brand-builder, not an ops person. You are inspiring, not operational. You set direction, tone and creative vision.

  • An exceptional communicator. You can face institutional allocators who care about regulation and licensing, and crypto-native counterparties who value speed and edge. You switch between both with ease.

  • Confident and assertive. You project authority. You bring conviction and directness - you challenge constructively and don't default to consensus. You bring edge, energy and a slightly audacious style.

  • Human-centric. You connect with people, build followership and bring teams along.

  • Detail-oriented. Despite the strategic focus, you sweat the details on brand consistency, messaging precision and design quality.

  • A challenger mindset. You dare to think differently, question the status quo and push things forward through constructive tension.

Our Recruitment Philosophy

We look for self-aware candidates who bring both the core skills required for the role and a deep alignment with our performance principles. We seek fiercely passionate, mission-driven people who communicate with purpose and practice proactive ownership. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who prioritizes mission over ego, maintains a commercial mindset, and delivers long-term value through pragmatic flexibility.

Experience and Background

Required

  • Significant experience in marketing leadership at a crypto or digital-asset firm

  • Deep understanding of the crypto market, its participants and its culture

  • Track record of building or transforming a brand in a fast-moving, commercially-driven environment

  • Strong communication skills Exceptional fluency in English, both written and spoken.

  • Based in or closely aligned with the CET time zone.

Preferred

  • Experience positioning a firm through a TradFi/crypto convergence narrative

  • Exposure to publicly listed or IPO-track companies

  • Familiarity with EU regulatory environment (MiCA) and how it shapes marketing and financial promotions

  • Experience working with or building AI-augmented marketing functions

Why Keyrock

  • Step-up opportunity. Own the function globally, report directly to the CCO, shape the brand from scratch.

  • Transformation moment. Keyrock is pivoting from appreciated-but-underrated to a firm that commands respect. This is a before-and-after career story.

  • Commercial partnership. Not a siloed marketing role. Deeply embedded in commercial strategy with commission upside.

  • Lean and AI-augmented. Small team, big impact. No bureaucratic bloat. Use agents and tools to move fast.

  • Global footprint. Offices across EU, UK, US and Switzerland. International exposure from day one.

  • Competitive offer. A competitive compensation package, attractive global benefits, and a performance-based variable.

  • Annual Team Retreats. A yearly offsite dedicated to strategy, celebration of our wins and fun team activities

raw.description:
About Keyrock

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

 

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

What we are looking for

We are seeking a Head of Risk to own and develop the Firm’s risk function end-to-end. This is a senior leadership role with direct accountability for the design, implementation and enforcement of a Firm-wide risk framework across all activities.

The role requires strong quantitative risk expertise and the ability to apply rigorous methodologies to complex, real-time markets across both traditional finance and digital assets. The successful candidate will co-design the firm’s risk architecture with the COO and CIO, covering data, analytics and real-time risk aggregation.

You will have full oversight of risk across trading (spot and derivatives), treasury and investments, including exposures across CeFi and DeFi environments. This includes defining risk appetite, implementing advanced risk metrics and ensuring disciplined risk-taking across the organization.

We are looking for a leader who sets the standard, challenges the business and enforces a strong risk culture, while enabling the firm to scale.

 
 

Role description

Quantitative Risk Framework: Develop and maintain a quantitative risk framework grounded in modern risk theory (e.g. market, credit, liquidity and systemic risk modelling), leveraging concepts such as tail risk, extreme value theory, dependence structures and stress testing

Firm-wide Risk System Architecture: Co-design and implement the Firm-wide risk management system in close collaboration with the COO and CIO, including data architecture, risk aggregation layers, real-time monitoring capabilities and reporting infrastructure across all business lines.

Cross-Asset & Cross-Infrastructure Risk Integration: Build an integrated risk view across centralized and decentralized venues, covering exchange risk, counterparty risk, smart contract risk, collateral efficiency and liquidity fragmentation.

Advanced Risk Modelling & Metrics: Define and implement advanced risk metrics (VaR, Expected Shortfall, stress scenarios, liquidity-adjusted risk, concentration risk) and ensure their consistent application across trading, treasury and investment activities.

Is plus: TradFi ↔ Crypto Risk Translation: Translate traditional financial risk methodologies into crypto-native environments, adapting models to account for 24/7 markets, fragmented liquidity, funding dynamics, on-chain transparency and new failure modes (e.g. oracle risk, protocol risk).

 
 

Background and Experience

System Design & Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven experience in designing or co-designing firm-wide risk systems, working closely with technology (CIO) and operations (COO) to translate risk requirements into scalable infrastructure.

TradFi + Crypto Hybrid Experience: Experience operating at the intersection of traditional financial markets and digital assets (CeFi and/or DeFi), with a strong understanding of differences in market structure, risk transmission and infrastructure.

Crypto-Specific Risk Understanding: Practical knowledge of crypto-specific risks, including exchange/custodian risk, smart contract risk, protocol risk, funding/basis dynamics and collateral management in both centralized and decentralized environments.

Competences and personality

  • Strong drive and proactivity to continuously strengthen the risk management in a fast-growing financial institution

Keyrock offers you both a career and a large range of benefits that we will gladly discuss in the course of the application process.

As an employer we are committed to building an inclusive, diverse and non-discriminating work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, creed and sexual orientation. We hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

raw.description:
Soho, London

Hybrid working: 3 days in the office Tues - Thurs

The Role

To provide technical leadership and hands-on contribution within a data engineering team, designing, building, and optimizing robust data pipelines and infrastructure for a global sports betting and media business. This role is crucial in delivering high-quality data solutions that support LiveScore's strategic goals and embody our commitment to being Fan Driven and a Champion of Sport. You will mentor junior engineers and ensure technical excellence in your domain.

At LiveScore Group, we're the proud home of three of the most exciting brands in the sports and gaming world: LiveScore, LiveScore Bet and Virgin Bet. A fully owned and operated ecosystem that converges the two worlds of sports media and sports betting. We're proud of the high ratings for our commitment to excellence and fueling fan's passion for sport driving us to the top.

We don't just lead; we innovate. Our cutting-edge products and immersive experiences set the standard, but it's our people who truly make the difference. Every day, our team embody our values: adaptability, teamwork, a fan-driven approach, and an ever-curious mindset that fuels our ambition. As we scale and continue to create a culture that allows all employees to thrive, we know we need the most talented people with diverse backgrounds, perspectives and skills. If you're good at what you do, come and join us. The more inclusive we are, the more amazing experiences we can create for our users.

We know that job descriptions can sometimes seem daunting, and you might not feel you tick every box. But, if you're passionate about the role and have relevant experience, we want to hear from you! 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Technical Leadership and Guidance: Act as a primary technical point of contact and subject matter expert for specific data engineering projects or domains, guiding team members through complex technical challenges and promoting innovative solutions.
  • End-to-End Data Solution Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy highly scalable, reliable, and fault-tolerant data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes. This includes data ingestion from diverse sources, data transformation, and data loading into various data stores (e.g., data warehouses, data lakes).
  • Architectural Implementation: Work closely with Data Architects to translate architectural blueprints and standards into concrete implementations, ensuring new data components align with the overall data strategy and infrastructure requirements.
  • Mentorship and Skill Development: Actively mentor and coach junior and mid-level data engineers, providing constructive feedback, sharing technical knowledge, and fostering their growth in coding, data modeling, and general data engineering best practices.
  • Hands-On Contribution: Maintain a significant hands-on role in coding, data modeling, infrastructure-as-code development, and platform configuration, leading by example and ensuring high-quality output.
  • Data Quality and Performance Assurance: Take direct responsibility for ensuring the quality, integrity, and performance of data assets within their assigned domain or projects, implementing monitoring, validation, and optimization strategies.
  • Operational Efficiency and Cost Optimization: Proactively identify and implement technical optimizations for data processing, storage, and infrastructure utilization to improve efficiency, reduce operational costs, and enhance system performance.
  • Code Review and Best Practices: Lead and participate in rigorous code reviews, advocating for and enforcing engineering best practices, coding standards, and architectural patterns to maintain high code quality and system stability.
  • Complex Problem Solving: Diagnose, troubleshoot, and provide effective solutions for highly complex data-related issues, incidents, and performance bottlenecks, often working under pressure.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with other engineering teams, product managers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements, integrate solutions, and provide technical insights.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience 

  • Advanced Data Pipeline Expertise: Proven, in-depth experience as a senior or lead data engineer with a strong portfolio of hands-on contributions to designing, building, and optimizing complex, large-scale data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes.
  • Enterprise Data Warehousing (EDW) and Data Modeling: Strong practical experience with EDW concepts, principles, and implementation, specifically including the design and practical application of a single, integrated data model for analytical purposes.
  • Cloud Data Platforms: Hands-on experience with cloud-native data services and infrastructure on at least one major cloud provider (e.g., AWS services like S3, Redshift, Glue, EMR; GCP services like BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub; Azure services like Data Lake, Synapse Analytics).
  • Cost Optimization Strategies: Demonstrated ability to identify, propose, and implement technical solutions that lead to significant cost savings in data processing, storage, and infrastructure within a large-scale data environment.
  • Software Engineering Fundamentals: Expert proficiency in software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum), version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and comprehensive understanding of software engineering best practices.
  • Programming Languages: Exceptional coding skills in at least one relevant programming language (e.g., Python, Scala, Java, JavaScript, C/C++), with a focus on writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
  • Database Systems: Extensive experience with various database technologies including relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra), and analytical data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery).
  • Data Architecture Principles: Solid understanding of data architecture patterns (e.g., Data Mesh, Data Lakehouse, Lambda/Kappa architectures), distributed systems, and their practical application.
  • Regulatory Reporting: Practical experience in developing and maintaining robust and auditable data solutions for regulatory reporting, particularly within the gaming or other highly regulated industries.
  • AI: Fluent in AI prompting alongside staying ahead of emerging AI technologies.
  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: A natural leader who can effectively guide, inspire, and technically mentor junior and mid-level engineers. Possesses the ability to break down complex problems, provide clear direction, and foster a learning environment, thereby enhancing team capabilities and promoting adherence to best practices.

What can we offer? 

  • Company Performance Bonus
  • Flexible Working Agreements where applicable
  • Private Healthcare Scheme + Employee Enhanced Assistance
  • Enhanced Family Leave - Maternity, Shared Parental & Adoption Leave: up to 6 months at full pay and 6 months at half pay. Paternity leave: up to 4 weeks at full pay
  • Subsidised Gym Membership
  • Annual Travel Card Loan & Ride to Work Scheme
  • Life Assurance (x3 salary)
  • Contributory Pension Plan

  • Thursday drinks in the office and regular socials

raw.title: AI Deployment Strategist, Critical and Sovereign Institutions - UK
raw.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role summary

As an AI Deployment Strategist, you will drive the adoption and deployment of Mistral's AI solutions, working closely with customers from strategic vision to production implementation.

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, AI innovation, and hands-on deployment, ensuring customers achieve transformative outcomes. You will partner with senior executives to design AI roadmaps, collaborate with the Applied AI team to deliver production solutions, and ensure smooth transitions from pre-sales to post-sales.

The Applied AI for Critical and Sovereign Institutions team is Mistral's specialized unit dedicated to delivering high-impact, secure AI solutions for institutions operating in highly regulated and strategic environments, including on-premise, disconnected, and air-gapped deployments. In this role, you will drive adoption inside sovereign institutions and critical infrastructure across the UK, partnering with senior leaders and mission owners under real operational, security, and compliance constraints to deliver projects with significant societal, operational, and strategic impact.

 

What you will do

 

Strategic discovery & vision setting

  • Lead executive-level and mission-owner workshops to identify challenges and opportunities where Mistral's AI can drive step-change improvements in strategic environments.

  • Co-create AI adoption roadmaps with customers, articulating the "art of the possible" and a clear path to value within their regulatory and security perimeter.

  • Collaborate with Account Executives to develop business cases, quantify impact, and align solutions with mission and organizational objectives.

AI solution design & deployment

  • Architect end-to-end AI solutions, integrating Mistral's models and platform into customer workflows and secure technical infrastructure (cloud, on-premise, disconnected, air-gapped).

  • Partner with the Applied AI team to design, prototype, and deploy AI solutions in production, ensuring scalability, security, and impact.

  • Own the execution of pilots and proofs-of-value, demonstrating the potential of our technology and paving the way for full-scale deployment.

Value realization & customer success

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, guiding their AI strategy and ensuring they maximize the value of their investment in Mistral.

  • Monitor key performance indicators tied to operational and business outcomes, and communicate progress to executive sponsors.

  • Proactively identify expansion opportunities across use cases and units, building on initial successes to drive long-term partnerships.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Act as the bridge between customers and Mistral's internal teams, synthesizing feedback to influence product, science, and security roadmaps.

  • Develop reusable assets, best practices, and playbooks to scale go-to-market efforts and ensure consistent delivery excellence in regulated settings.

  • Travel (~30-60%) to foster deep client relationships and support on-site deployment.

     

What we're looking for

  • 2+ years in a client-facing strategic and technical role (e.g. data science consulting, value engineering, or technical sales).

  • A degree in a relevant scientific field (e.g. Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering).

  • Foundational knowledge of AI/ML/Data Science, with the credibility to advise both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying AI applications (Python, JavaScript, or similar) to demonstrate value.

  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous challenges into actionable solutions.

  • Executive presence and communication skills to influence senior stakeholders (VP, C-level, mission owners).

  • Resilient, results-driven, and comfortable leading through influence in a collaborative environment.

  • Comfort operating under security, compliance, and confidentiality constraints.

Nice to have

  • Experience with sales qualification frameworks (e.g. MEDDPICC) and value-based selling.

  • Experience deploying AI in regulated or sovereign environments (defence, public sector, critical infrastructure).

 

Security & compliance (vertical-specific):

  • Eligibility: must be a UK national

  • Clearable: must meet all requirements for UK national security vetting (e.g. Security Check (SC) and/or Developed Vetting (DV)), including no relevant criminal record and the ability to satisfy residency and background checks.

 

Why This Role Matters

 

You will play a pivotal role in shaping how enterprises adopt and deploy AI, ensuring Mistral’s solutions deliver measurable impact. By partnering with the Applied AI team, you’ll help turn strategic visions into production-ready solutions, making Mistral an indispensable partner for our customers.

 
 

Hiring Process

 

• Talent Acquisition screening call

• 30min Hiring Manager Interview

• 45min Business Acumen Interview

• 60min Technical Deep Dive on LLMs

• Panel (Home Prep & Restitution)

• 30min Value Talk

• Reference check

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

raw.description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

Our clinics depend on technology that simply works: the network, the devices and the rooms members walk into for their scan and debrief. As Lead Corporate Engineer in London, you’ll work alongside the Corporate Engineering team to provide industry-leading support services and build solutions.

You’ll provide generalist support to the company at our London HQ and, on top of that, be Corporate Engineering’s domain expert for network and security, the key contact for our network and AV partners, and the person on site when a clinic opening or incident needs hands-on ownership. Over time, you’ll shape how we run our network as Neko scales, with member experience and long-term reliability as the test for every decision.

What You’ll Deliver in the First 6-12 Months

  • Own network incidents end to end across Cisco Meraki (MX/MS/MR), LAN/WAN, VPN and firewall as the primary contact for our network partner, reducing escalations to the wider team (Impact, not activity).

  • Lead clinic-room readiness for new openings, coordinating AV vendors and Facilities and Clinic leads so Sonos, Soundtrack, Dante and debrief-room displays are tested and handed over on time (Member-first, always).

  • Take delegated ownership of the network partner relationship and set out a long-term operating model for the network, making clear trade-offs on what Neko should own directly (Chase 10X, not 10%).

  • Establish working coverage of Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune and Defender XDR, and ship at least one PowerShell or Graph automation that removes a recurring manual process (Tech-enabled, human-centred).

  • Document network architecture, configurations and troubleshooting procedures for London and partner-managed infrastructure, raising the wider team’s network capability.

  • Recommend and build new processes, systems and tooling for Corporate Engineering, acting as a builder of solutions as well as a supporter of existing ones.

  • Partner with our global teams on shared systems and standards, and travel to US sites for onsite requirements & deployment activities

Minimum Qualifications

  • Strong networking fundamentals (LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, DHCP, DNS, Wi-Fi), hands-on Cisco Meraki (MX/MS/MR) troubleshooting, and working knowledge of Azure networking (VPN, Point-to-Site, VNets, NSGs).

  • Proven experience as the technical point of contact for a network vendor or managed service provider, owning incidents, planned changes, ISP issues and site deployments from investigation through validation.

  • Hands-on, on-site support of busy multi-site environments such as offices, retail, hospitality or clinics, built on a grounding in IT operations.

  • Administration of Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Conditional Access, SSO, Enterprise Applications) and Intune across Windows, macOS and iOS, with working knowledge of Defender XDR.

  • PowerShell scripting for administration and repeatable operations, and confident use of AI to draft scripts, document incidents and speed up diagnosis, with clear judgement on where hands-on verification is needed.

  • Clear documentation and communication: you can explain a technical issue to a clinic lead or a non-technical leader, and hold your ground with a vendor.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Clinic or venue AV systems (Sonos amplifiers, Soundtrack, Dante audio, meeting-room displays and NUCs), including coordinating AV vendor access for testing and handover.

  • Microsoft Graph or API experience for workflow and operational automation.

  • New office or site launches in a fast-scaling company, from build to first day of business.

  • Experience migrating between platforms or bringing outsourced services in-house.

Our clinics depend on technology that simply works: the network, the devices and the rooms members walk into for their scan and debrief. As Lead Corporate Engineer in London, you’ll work alongside the Corporate Engineering team to provide industry-leading support services and build solutions.

You’ll provide generalist support to the company at our London HQ and, on top of that, be Corporate Engineering’s domain expert for network and security, the key contact for our network and AV partners, and the person on site when a clinic opening or incident needs hands-on ownership. What You’ll Deliver in the First 6-12 Months

  • Establish working coverage of Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune and Defender XDR, and ship at least one PowerShell or Graph automation that removes a recurring manual process (Tech-enabled, human-centred).

Role Purpose

The Leadership & Culture Development Lead owns how Neko's leaders are developed and how the leadership bar shows up in practice, plus which culture products get built and how they deploy across markets.

This role merges leadership and culture development deliberately: it is broader than either would be alone, and the combination is what earns the credibility to coach and challenge the ELT. It sits on the two priorities CHROs rank first and second for 2026.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • Onboard every new leader into Neko's leadership standards, Vitals and culture code from day one of their leadership role. (Member-first, Always)

  • Turn the Neko leadership model into ongoing practice — coaching, mentorship, scans — with a measurable improvement in leadership capability, not a one-off training event. (Impact, Not Activity)

  • Ship a reusable culture product library that any market or clinic can deploy without this role being in the room. (Chase 10X, Not 10%)

  • Run the first leadership and culture scans that show where the gaps are and what to do about them. (Optimistic Truth-seeking)

  • Direct the AI Enablement releases: i.e leadership buddy and culture buddy live and in use by real leaders. (Tech-enabled, Human-centred)

Responsibilities

Leadership development

  • Own how leaders are developed and what the leadership bar looks like in practice.

  • Design and run leadership development programmes and leadership scans.

  • Provide coaching and mentorship directly to leaders, including holding the standard with the ELT.

Culture

  • Own culture design and iteration, ways of working, and input into the EVP.

  • Decide which culture products get built and how they are deployed across HQ and clinics.

  • Own culture activations that reinforce the Vitals in day-to-day work, not just at onboarding.

Decisions & Authority

  • Owns the leadership development and culture product roadmap.

  • Authority to coach and challenge ELT members on leadership behaviour; carries a credibility floor for this.

  • Directs the AI Enablement priorities within the frameworks this role sets.

Minimum Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Required — Has personally built something with AI — an agent, tool, script, or workflow — even an experiment that didn't scale. We're screening for hands-on builder evidence, not familiarity with AI as a concept.

  • Track record designing and running a leadership development programme at a scaling company, ideally 500–2,000 employees.

  • Experience building or evolving a company culture framework, including translating it into concrete products, not just a values deck.

  • Direct coaching experience with senior leaders, including giving unwelcome feedback to people more senior than them.

Skills & Competencies

  • Can turn an abstract leadership model into a scan, a coaching product and a habit — not just a slide.

  • Executive presence: credible challenging ELT members on leadership behaviour.

  • People management: sets direction for a builder role without micromanaging the build.

  • AI fluency: knows which parts of leadership and culture coaching are safe to delegate to an agent, and which require a human.

Mission & Vitals Alignment

  • Believes leadership capability is the highest-leverage lever available and acts like it, not like a training administrator.

  • Optimistic truth-seeker: delivers hard leadership feedback with care, not with a manual for tenure.

  • Comfortable being new at the top table: this credibility has to be earned in the room, not inherited from title.

raw.description:
Our Mission

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The role

We're hiring the first dedicated owner of Omnea's performance marketing.

You're not starting from scratch. Paid campaigns, the website and our social channels all exist (and are working to varying degrees). But nobody's job is to work out what actually produces pipeline and then make more of it. That's this role: take what's already running, find the ROI, and professionalise it into something we can be proud of.

In one week you might work out why a paid campaign is generating leads that never convert, rebuild the landing page that's losing them, build a new LinkedIn audience off the back of our closed-won data, and show the exec team what the pipeline picture looks like.

If you want to run one channel and hand-off the numbers, this might not be for you. If you want to own the loop from spend through to pipeline, and have the data to prove what worked, it is.

You'll work closely with our digital agency partners, the field marketers running events in the UK and US, and the sales team who rely on the pipeline you generate.

What you'll own

Pipeline and performance

You'll build the picture of what marketing is actually returning, and you'll be the person with the answer when someone asks whether a channel is worth the money.

  • Own the pipeline number for our digital channels: how much, from where, and at what cost

  • Build and maintain dashboards in Dreamdata using sources like HubSpot and GA4

  • Track campaigns from first touch through to closed won, and use what you find to change what we run next

  • Run a proper testing cadence. Set the test, call the result, and stop the things that aren't working

  • Report on what the numbers mean, not only what they are

Paid

You own paid. Our agency handles campaign build and optimisation, and you set the direction they work to.

  • Act as day-to-day partner to the agency: set the brief, shape audience strategy and funnel design, and decide together what to test next and how to deploy 6-figure annual ad spend.

  • Own LinkedIn as our primary paid channel: audiences, target account lists, retargeting and sequencing

  • Build audiences from our own data: closed-won patterns, target accounts, product signals - rather than off-the-shelf targeting

  • Work with content and design teammates to produce compelling content

  • Make the case for more budget when the numbers justify it

Website and conversion

  • Own conversion across the site: forms, journeys, page structure, and what happens after someone clicks an ad

  • Build and update pages using our existing component library and CMS

  • Run an ongoing testing programme on the pages that matter, and work with the in-house design team on what comes next

  • Ship landing pages for campaigns and product launches, including forms and tracking

  • Keep tracking and attribution clean, so the reporting can be trusted

What we're looking for

  • Experience in a B2B marketing role, in-house or agency. We care more about what you delivered than where you did it.

  • You're commercial. You think in pipeline and cost per opportunity, not clicks and impressions, and you can tell the difference between a campaign that's busy and one that's working.

  • You know paid mechanics properly. Audiences, match rates, attribution windows, frequency. LinkedIn Ads specifically.

  • You're comfortable with numbers. You can build a report from scratch, spot when something looks wrong, and explain a trend to someone who wasn't in the weeds with you.

  • You've built pages in a CMS. Not from scratch in code — assembling pages from components, keeping them consistent, and getting the tracking right.

  • You've worked with or inside an agency, so you know how to write a brief and how to tell good work from work that's merely on time.

Nice to have

  • Comfortable in tools like HubSpot, Dreamdata, Google Ads, Campaign Manager

  • B2B SaaS, ideally selling to finance, procurement, legal or risk

  • SEO fundamentals

  • Enough Figma to work sensibly with designers

What good looks like in six months

  • We know what every pound of adspend returns, and everyone trusts the number

  • Paid is producing pipeline we can attribute, at a cost we're happy to scale

  • Our LinkedIn audiences are built from our own data rather than off-the-shelf targeting

  • The pages that carry the most traffic have been tested and improved

  • You're the person the exec team asks when they want to know whether a channel is working

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

About the Role

Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy.

You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage a small number of complex accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan

  • Lead our enterprise prospects’ journeys from consideration to successful deployment

  • Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects

  • Own a consumption revenue target

  • Manage consumption revenue forecasts

raw.title: Applied AI Architect, Education
raw.description:
About the Team

The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.

Within Education, we partner with universities, schools, research institutions, and countrywide education systems to advance responsible, mission-aligned uses of AI. These environments require more than technical deployment: success depends on institutional trust, thoughtful governance, stakeholder education, change management, and a value narrative that resonates with academic leaders, researchers, IT teams, faculty, administrators, and students.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Architect for Education, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of education customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business,” shaping each institution’s AI strategy and guiding its journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable institutional impact.

You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Edu, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate institutional priorities into a focused portfolio of use cases, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable value and growth. The Account Director owns the commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.

You will work across academic, research, administrative, and operational contexts—helping customers determine where AI can responsibly improve teaching and learning, accelerate research, strengthen student and faculty services, and make institutional operations more effective. You will account for the realities of education environments, including shared governance, complex stakeholder networks, academic calendars, accessibility, data privacy, responsible-AI expectations, and the need to build confidence among communities with differing levels of AI readiness.

You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, education programs, and partners. This role calls for strong education-sector fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy, academic and operational workflows, and hands-on technical conversations.

In this role, you will:

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing education customers and pre-sales prospects.

  • Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, value-realization path, and expansion opportunities.

  • Lead discovery with institutional executives, academic leaders, researchers, faculty, administrators, and technical teams to identify and prioritize use cases connected to meaningful institutional objectives.

  • Translate institutional objectives into actionable adoption roadmaps with clear workstreams, sequencing, milestones, stakeholder ownership, governance, risks, success measures, and change-management needs.

  • Build trusted relationships and technical champions across CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, provosts, deans, research leaders, faculty, administrators, and other institutional stakeholders.

  • Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, Product, Research, education specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.

  • Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.

  • Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.

  • Identify repeatable education patterns and reusable architectures that can accelerate responsible adoption across institutions, departments, campuses, and education systems.

  • Translate field insights into actionable feedback for Product, Engineering, and Research, representing the needs and production patterns of education customers.

  • Help identify expansion opportunities where OpenAI can support additional academic, research, administrative, or operational workflows.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.

  • Have guided complex organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable value realization.

  • Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.

  • Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.

  • Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.

  • Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.

  • Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.
