raw.title: Senior Treasury Operations Analyst
raw.description:
Trust unlocks our greatest potential.

For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution.

What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’.

What you can expect:

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our Treasury Operations team as a Senior Treasury Operations Analyst? Reporting to the Treasury Operations Lead, you will support Treasury Operations activities across ClearBank Group entities, including cash management, FX settlement, collateral and margin management and related processes. The role is responsible for executing complex operational activity with a high degree of accuracy and control, supporting day‑to‑day Treasury and contributing to the safe, resilient operation of a control‑critical function, while ensuring excellent service to internal and external stakeholders. As a senior member of the team, the role will deputise for the Treasury Operations Lead when required, providing operational leadership on shift, including coaching and direction to team members, while identifying efficiencies and continuous improvements across the function.

Please note - This role operates within a shift‑based Treasury Operations environment. Specific shift arrangements are communicated separately and may vary over time.

Your role includes:

  • Execute Treasury Operations activities across multiple ClearBank Group entities and multi‑currency Nostro accounts, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and strong control discipline

  • Perform and monitor FX settlement activity with multiple FX providers, resolving issues and exceptions within agreed procedures

  • Support cash and liquidity management processes, working closely with Treasury to manage intraday and end‑of‑day balances

  • Manage collateral and margin activity relating to UK securities, including transfers, settlement and ongoing monitoring of asset sales

  • Ensure all Treasury and cash management instruments, including FX swaps and money market funds, are confirmed and settled without exceptions

  • Deputise for the Treasury Operations Shift Manager when required, leading operational activity on shift and acting as a point of escalation within established BAU and contingency procedures

  • Exercise sound judgement during live operational issues, escalating in a timely manner where there is a high degree of certainty that existing processes or controls may fail

  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance Treasury Operations processes, controls and workflows

  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal teams and, where required, external counterparties to support smooth operational delivery

  • Produce operational reporting and management information as required to support oversight and decision‑making

  • Support the onboarding and operation of new Treasury instruments and products as ClearBank Group’s offering evolves

What you’ll bring:

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

  • Experience in Treasury Operations, cash management or payments operations within a regulated financial services environment

  • Strong working knowledge of FX settlement, Nostro account management and liquidity processes

  • Experience managing or supporting collateral and margin activity, including securities settlement

  • Proven ability to operate effectively in a time‑critical or shift‑based environment

  • Sound understanding of operational risk, controls and escalation frameworks

  • Experience producing or contributing to operational reporting and MI

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to work confidently across teams and with external parties

Beneficial skills:

  • Experience supporting multiple legal entities and currencies

  • Exposure to new product or instrument launches within Treasury or Operations

  • Knowledge of UK securities settlement processes and market infrastructure

  • Experience contributing to process improvement or operational change initiatives

Regretfully we are not able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes at the current time.

What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you?

  • You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank;

  • You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care;

  • You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate;

  • ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

What we offer in return:

  • We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance.

  • Offices – Work in a way that works for you – whether that’s in the London office, at home, or hybrid.

  • Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus bank holidays.

  • Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most.

  • Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the UK for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period.

  • Socials – Regular social events open to all.

  • Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice.

  • Wellbeing – 24/7 employee assistance programme including mental health support, life assurance and income protection.

  • Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you.

  • Healthy living – Private healthcare and discounted dental cover, with employee perks and discounts.

  • Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave.

  • Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning.

And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.

offer.title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud

raw.title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.

We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.

This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.

We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.

This role will be based in London, UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.
  • Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.
  • Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.
  • Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.

raw.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Case Management
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Role overview

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help build and evolve our new Common case-management system, which powers support-case handling across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.

You will own significant end-to-end initiatives across our backend services: case lifecycle, routing and assignment, queue management, case evidence and history, and migration from legacy systems. This is a hands-on role for someone who can turn ambiguous customer and operational problems into durable technical solutions, coordinate other engineers, and set the standard for reliability and craftsmanship on the team.

What you'll do

  • Lead one or more project-level Case Management initiatives, on your own or by guiding a group of engineers, from discovery and design through rollout, measurement, and operational ownership.
  • Design and build scalable backend services and APIs for case creation, routing, assignment, transfers, audit history, notes, attachments, and queue-management workflows.
  • Help deliver feature parity with legacy platforms while safely migrating traffic across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.
  • Make and own most technical decisions within your scope. Write project-level design documents covering how sub-features interact, identify dependencies and risks, and break work into parallelizable delivery plans.
  • Scope ambiguous customer and operational problems, weigh long-term against short-term trade-offs, and design durable solutions.
  • Partner with Product, Operations, Support, Data, and other engineering teams to define the right problems. Shape the team roadmap through prototypes, data analysis, project proposals, and backlog prioritization.
  • Run the coordination a project needs, such as status updates and dependency tracking, and escalate early to keep delivery on time.
  • Enforce team-wide quality objectives: lead design reviews, calibrate quality metrics, and improve logging, monitoring, alerting, and escalation policies.
  • Serve as first responder or incident commander, model good incident practice, and turn what you learn into playbooks and backlog work.
  • Introduce and guide AI best practices for the team, including evals, data privacy, and review of AI-generated code, and take part in AI-powered projects when they are central to the product.
  • Design reusable, self-serviceable solutions, and consider cost efficiency, including compute and AI costs, in key designs.
  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, design guidance, tech talks, and constructive feedback. Interview candidates, join sell calls, and take part in hiring events when the team needs them.

Must-have qualifications

  • Strong backend engineering experience, including designing and operating backend services, APIs, asynchronous workflows, and data models at meaningful scale.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern backend language, and a record of writing exemplary code for the core functionality of key components.
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex, customer-facing or operations-critical projects from technical design through production rollout.
  • Experience breaking projects into parallelizable work, identifying dependencies and risks, and giving accurate estimates for yourself and others.
  • Hands-on experience using AI development tools to improve productivity, while validating generated output for correctness, security, privacy, maintainability, and reliability.
  • Strong product judgment: the ability to turn ambiguous workflows and user needs into simple, maintainable technical solutions.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across functions, bring the right stakeholders into decisions at the right time, and explain trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong engineering craft: testing, code review, observability, incident response, security, and operational readiness, with experience designing for reliability.
  • Comfort working on systems with high correctness and auditability requirements, including traceability of decisions and changes.
  • A mentoring mindset and a record of raising team-wide engineering standards.

Nice-to-have qualifications

  • Go experience.
  • Experience with migration from legacy systems, gradual rollouts, traffic shadowing, and feature-parity programs.
  • Experience supporting internal tools or operational user interfaces from the backend side.
  • Experience with high-volume, multi-region, or multi-tenant systems.
  • Experience as an incident commander or in running an on-call rotation.
  • Experience building AI-powered features, including evaluation of model output.

What success looks like

  • Delivers a major Case Management initiative with clear technical ownership, predictable execution, and measurable customer or business impact.
  • Improves the reliability, maintainability, and cost efficiency of the Common system while enabling safe migration from legacy case-management systems.
  • Helps move support traffic onto the Common system without reducing case-resolution quality.
  • Builds solutions that other engineers and operators can confidently reuse and operate.
  • Acts as a technical leader within the team: unblocks peers and partner teams, improves engineering decisions, influences the roadmap, and strengthens cross-functional execution.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Senior Software Engineer

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale.

The Team: 

MX Intelligence builds the tools DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt use to find, sign and onboard restaurants and merchants. That covers identifying and matching prospective merchants through to the CRM, quoting and contracting tools sales teams use to bring them onto the platform. We're replacing a Salesforce-based stack with one first-party platform shared across all three brands.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our London (Hybrid - 3 days from the office) team. In this role, you'll help us improve code structure and architecture while leading team project planning to maximise efficiency and reliability across our production systems.

Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You'll Be Doing

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Drive Technical Excellence: Improve code structure and architecture across your team's remit, performing high-impact code reviews to ensure quality and scalability.

  • Lead Project Planning: Foresee dependencies and risks, partnering closely with Product and Design to ensure smooth delivery of complex features.

  • Optimise Operations: Simplify the maintenance and operation of production systems, promoting visibility, health, and operational readiness.

  • Collaborate & Influence: Build relationships across engineering teams to identify collaboration opportunities and influence the wider technical roadmap.

  • Mentor & Hire: Support the personal growth of your colleagues through technical guidance and take an active role in conducting engineering interviews to scale our team.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Strong Engineering Principles: Deep pride in writing readable, well-designed, and well-tested software.

  • Backend Expertise: Significant experience building web-based applications (we use Go, Ruby/Rails, Python, Scala, and Rust).

  • Data Proficiency: Practical experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and "NoSQL" backends like Redis, DynamoDB, or ElasticSearch.

  • Systems at Scale: Proven ability to manage web architecture at scale (handling 20krpm and above).

  • Technical Leadership: Experience breaking down large pieces of work and guiding implementation choices for a team of engineers.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers, proud parents, and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide here to help you feel confident at each stage.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Software Engineers, Subscriptions - Backend

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, one of the largest online food ordering and delivery platforms in the world. As part of this role, you'll join one of our Subscriptions teams in London, focused on the core proposition and working across our three subscription programmes - DashPass, Deliveroo Plus, and Wolt+. You'll work closely with engineering teams across the US and Europe, as part of the Global Subscription organisation, to build and evolve the shared subscriptions capabilities that power loyalty and membership experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

We're hiring backend engineers who want to be at the front line of what engineering looks like in the age of AI.

💡 Why Subscriptions? 

  • An AI-first team by design. We don't use AI as a productivity add-on - we treat agentic coding as a core engineering discipline. We expect our engineers to build with AI agents, to challenge what's possible when the human-in-the-loop is a multiplier rather than a bottleneck, and to push the boundaries of what a small, focused team can ship.
  • Real ownership, real impact. Our subscription programmes are touching millions of users daily. You'll own features end-to-end - from the idea through production - and see your work matter at scale.
  • Cross-org engineering at the frontier. Deliveroo,  DoorDash and Wolt are working together in order to align subscription experiences across three of the world's leading delivery platforms. This is engineering at the intersection of product ambition and international complexity.
  • A small team that punches above its weight. We're a cross-functional team: Backend, Mobile, Web, Product, Design, and Data - all in the same room. No handoff theatre. You'll move fast, ship iteratively, and be around people who take craft seriously.

🤖 AI-First Engineering - What This Means Here

We're building teams at the forefront of agentic coding. This isn't about using Copilot to autocomplete boilerplate. We mean engineers who:

  • Design workflows where AI agents handle entire task loops, from spec to PR.
  • Think in terms of orchestration: what does a human review, what does the agent own?
  • Build internal tooling and abstractions that make AI-assisted development faster and more reliable for the whole team.
  • Stay curious and ahead of the curve - trying new models, agents, and tools as they emerge, and forming strong opinions about what's genuinely useful vs. hype.

If you find yourself naturally asking "can an agent do this?" before reaching for the keyboard, you'll fit right in.

🔍 What We're Looking For Across all roles

  • Strong engineering fundamentals - you've built and shipped software that runs at scale, and you understand what that entails: testing, observability, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI-first development. You use AI tools daily and have formed real opinions about how to get the most out of them.
  • Ownership mentality: you drive projects forward, communicate clearly across teams and time zones, and don't wait to be told what to do.
  • Collaborative instincts - the Subscriptions domain sits at the intersection of consumer mobile, web, backend, and data. Cross-functional work is the norm, not the exception.

🙌 About You 

  • You've built and shipped real software - products, platforms, APIs, apps - and you know what it takes to keep things running reliably in production. You have opinions about architecture but hold them lightly. You write tests. You read the alerts. You don't leave loose ends.
  • What sets you apart right now is that you're genuinely excited about where engineering is going. You've been experimenting with AI agents and agentic coding workflows - not because someone told you to, but because you couldn't help yourself. You think about how to redesign your development loop from first principles, not how to bolt AI onto the way you already work.
  • You communicate well, collaborate easily across disciplines, and care about the product as much as the code. You're the kind of engineer who asks "what's the best way to..." and then actually follows through.

🌍 Where You'll Work 

These roles are based in our tech hub in London.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the team

Engineering the future of customer support — at global scale 🌍

We believe exceptional customer service is more than just a feature, it's a fundamental part of who we are. That's why we've built our own internal support tooling from the ground up, tailored to help our customer, courier, and merchant support teams shine in every interaction.

As we scale our operations from 30 to 60 countries, supporting millions of users and partners, our internal tools need to scale with us. The Support Engineering group is at the heart of this mission. We build high-performance admin applications and core operational tools that empower our support teams to work smarter and faster. A key part of this is our in-house chat platform, which already handles around 5 million conversations every month. On top of this foundation, we're developing advanced features to reduce manual work, improve communication, and proactively resolve issues — often before our users even notice them.

Our systems range from automated reach-outs for delayed orders to deeply integrated tools that enable our support teams to deliver assistance quickly, reliably, and with a human touch. By removing inefficiencies and automating repetitive tasks, we're ensuring that our users and partners receive world-class support at scale.

 

About the role

We're now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to join us in building scalable, low-latency systems that power these tools and shape the future of customer support. You'll work on impactful products that directly influence how millions of people experience our platform every day.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain high-throughput backend services using Go.

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and frontend developers to ship features that support internal support agents across the globe.

  • Design systems that are scalable, resilient, and easy to maintain.

  • Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decision-making.

  • Write well-tested code and help the team maintain high code quality standards.

     

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and scaling complex systems.

  • Production experience in Golang, with an interest in developing strong engineering practices.

  • Strong hands-on experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases — especially Cassandra.

  • Solid understanding of designing and operating low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems.

  • Previous on-call experience, with a pragmatic approach to reliability and incident management.

 

Nice to have

  • Background in Node.js or other backend languages.

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and event-driven architectures.

     

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. We recognise that some candidates may require adjustments to apply for a position or fairly participate in the interview process. If you require any adjustments, please don't hesitate to let us know. We will make every effort to provide the necessary adjustments to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

raw.description:
Senior Solutions Engineer – UK & Ireland

Location: UK (hybrid), covering UK & Ireland 

There has never been a better time to join Extreme. Recent acquisitions have broadened our portfolio, the UK & Ireland region is growing fast, and we are a Gartner Magic Quadrant leader with a culture built on diversity, inclusion and equality.

The role

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you'll be the technical lead on strategic accounts across the UK & Ireland, shaping complex solutions from first conversation to close. You'll also mentor other SEs, enable our partners and represent Extreme in the market.


What you'll do:
  • Own the technical strategy for complex deals across enterprise, public sector, healthcare, education and CNI.
  • Design end-to-end solutions across fabric, wireless, SD-WAN, security and cloud management.
  • Lead RFP and tender responses (including public sector frameworks), PoCs and demonstrations.
  • Present with impact, from engineering teams to CIO and board level.
  • Build trusted relationships with customers and partners, and advocate for them internally.
  • Mentor SEs, lead partner and MSP enablement, and step up as account technical lead when needed.

    • Travel is required, mainly across the UK and Ireland.


What you'll bring:
  • Typically 7+ years in networking pre-sales, with a record of closing large, complex deals.
  • Deep knowledge of L2/3 switching, IPv4/v6 routing, fabric and overlays (SPB, VXLAN/EVPN), Wi-Fi design and network security.
  • Excellent presentation skills and strong hands-on lab and PoC experience.
  • Tenacity, ownership and a customer-first mindset.

    • Desirable: cloud-managed networking, virtualization, SD-WAN/SASE, automation and APIs, partner enablement, UK public sector experience or SC clearance, and industry certifications (Extreme certifications welcome, not required).

    ***OTE is on a 70/30 split and based on qualifications and experience with a range between 100-120K 

    Extreme Networks Benefits

     

About Extreme

Extreme uses cloud management, machine learning and AI to simplify and secure the network for more than 30,000 customers and 10 million daily users. Extreme Networks is an equal opportunity employer.

raw.title: Account Executive - FlexiPay
raw.description:
We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else 🚀

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.

At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.

We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.

The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!

[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]

The role ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 3 days in the office | 💰 £30,000 - £35,000 + OTE

This is an exciting opportunity to join our FlexiPay Sales team and play a part in scaling one of Funding Circle’s newest products! This is a fantastic starting point to a challenging and rewarding career in B2B sales.

As an Account Executive in FlexiPay, you embody one of our most important selling points: personal support for our customers. Every day you will speak to a diverse range of SME business owners to gain an understanding of their business, find out about their goals and explain how Funding Circle can help in achieving them. You will be:

  • Responsible for driving sign-ups, converting leads and encouraging repeat usage of the product whilst also collecting valuable customer insights that will feed directly into the ongoing development of the FlexiPay product

  • Establishing instant rapport with your customers via telephone & email to cultivate successful relationships

  • Pitching the Funding Circle proposition against alternative funding options available

  • Managing a high-volume, fast-paced pipeline; supporting your clients through each stage of the application

  • Being responsible for your own monthly target and continuously developing & improving your approach to help you get there

  • Proactively problem solving, identifying and confidently mitigating any risks, issues or control weaknesses that arise in your day-to-day

 

What we’re looking for 🌱

  • Experience of working in a telesales or phone based environment

  • Motivated by success in numbers and driven to achieve your monthly targets

  • Able to easily connect with people and demonstrate natural interpersonal skills - including teamwork!

  • Good organisation skills and ability to manage your workload autonomously

  • Quick to learn and invested in your own development

We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.

Why join us? 💜

We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!

Our Circler Proposition focuses on five areas:

  • Flexibility: We provide a benefit allowance you can tailor to your own life and family.

  • Health: This includes private medical and dental, health assessments, and access to a digital GP.

  • Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.

  • Development: You get a dedicated annual learning allowance to help you level up.

  • Lifestyle: We have electric car and cycle-to-work schemes, plus season ticket loans.

We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.

Ready to join a mission that matters? We’d love to chat!

raw.title: AI Enablement Lead
raw.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

 

The role

AI is reshaping how legal work gets done, and at Legora we're not just watching that happen — we're building it from the inside.

Our AI Enablement function exists to make sure every team at Legora can build, use, and govern AI well. The function is young, the mandate is broad, and right now it's one person. You'd be joining to own a significant slice of that work — managing engineers, translating business needs into action, and becoming the go-to for anything AI across the organization.

This is a high-ownership generalist seat for someone energized by ambiguity who would rather figure it out and ship than wait for a perfect brief.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

We operate across three streams — you'll own initiatives in all of them, from rough idea to shipped result:

Build

  • Coordinate agent and internal tool builds with engineers, keeping projects moving and translating between business needs and technical direction.

Enable

  • Run training, workshops, and documentation that help teams adopt AI.

  • Build and grow an AI champions program across the org.

  • Be the day-to-day support that makes enablement actually land.

Govern

  • Draft and operationalize guidelines, access policies, and usage guardrails.

  • Put the standards in place that let us move fast safely.

Across all three, you'll act as a connector — building the relationships and touchpoints that make the function visible and trusted.

 

Who You Are

  • Technical foundation: engineering degree (or equivalent), enough coding exposure to hold your own with engineers.

  • A few years in a fast-moving environment — ops, strategy, product, consulting, program management, or similar. Shape matters more than title.

  • Genuinely AI-native, or clearly on the way: you reach for AI tools by default and want to go deeper.

  • True generalist: comfortable switching between strategy, delivery, and people work in the same day.

  • Exceptional learning speed — you get to depth on unfamiliar things fast and take feedback in quickly.

  • Strong communicator with a low-ego, collaborative style.

 

Nice to have

  • Exposure to legal, GTM, or a regulated / high-trust environment.

  • Experience with agent platforms, workflow tools, or no/low-code AI.

  • A track record of starting something from scratch.

 

What Success Looks Like (the first 6 months)

  • You’re independently owning initiatives end-to-end across all three streams.

  • You've taken real ground on at least one initiative in each stream.

  • You’re a go to person for questions on AI Enablement at Legora.

 

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

Legora has grown from 40 people to more than 1,000 in 18 months and our Talent Acquisition function is now entering its next chapter. The processes, standards, and hiring approach that support our next phase of growth are being built today, which you’ll play a significant part in. You'll work closely with senior leaders from day one and play a key role in shaping how Legora hires and scales.

What you’ll do

Revenue growth depends on having the right commercial talent in place, fast, and at a high bar. As a Senior Talent Partner, you will own that directly. You are not a support function for the Go To Market (GTM) team. You are a commercial operator in your own right, accountable for the quality and velocity of the people who drive Legora's growth.

You will own end-to-end hiring across GTM in EMEA, working closely with senior leaders who are genuinely invested in recruiting, trusted to make high-impact decisions on hiring and team composition.

Specifically, you will:

  • Help shape how Talent operates at Legora, contributing beyond hiring to process design, programs, tooling, and broader People initiatives.

  • Own full-cycle recruitment across EMEA, acting as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to hiring managers and senior leaders to define role scope, success profiles, and hiring strategies aligned to business priorities.

  • Raise the bar for the Talent team by mentoring and developing fellow Talent Acquisition Partners, supporting new joiners, and sharing best practices across teams.

  • Build and nurture proactive talent pipelines for critical and future hiring needs, ensuring we stay ahead of demand rather than reacting to it.

  • Run structured, data-informed hiring processes that balance quality, pace, and consistency while maintaining a high bar for talent.

  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience from first conversation through to offer, acting as a trusted and credible ambassador for Legora throughout.

What you bring

You understand that hiring decisions are business decisions, and you hold yourself accountable to the same outcomes as the teams you hire for. You're hands-on, sharp, and trusted by senior leaders to shape teams that win. We're looking for:

  • Over five years of experience in talent acquisition in a high-growth environment, startup, scaleup, or VC-backed company, with meaningful depth hiring GTM talent.

  • A proven track record hiring high-performing GTM talent across the seniority levels that matter most at this stage of growth.

  • Genuine commercial acumen. You understand OTE structures, quota attainment, and how a hire affects revenue trajectory, and you use that fluency to advise hiring managers and close exceptional candidates.

  • Experience partnering with senior stakeholders on hiring strategy and team build-out, not just executing briefs, but shaping them.

  • The ability to run multiple complex searches without losing quality or pace.

  • Comfortable in ambiguity with a bias toward action. You build a structure where none exists and move without waiting for perfect conditions.

About us

At Legora, we're on a mission to transform the way lawyers work. Our AI-native platform helps legal professionals work more efficiently, collaborate more effectively, and focus on the work that matters most. We build closely with our clients, move at a market-leading pace, and are scaling rapidly across teams and geographies.

Legal Data is the foundation of what Legora knows. The team decides which legal sources our users can rely on (legislation, case law, and commentary from leading publishers) and makes them available across a growing number of markets, through our own content build and partnerships with publishers and institutions worldwide.

The role

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help Legal Data decide where to invest globally—and build the systems and cross-functional processes that turn those decisions into delivery. You'll connect client demand, content usage and partnership opportunities for digital collection to clear priorities, and create the operating model that helps the team scale.

You'll bring structure to a fast-moving area without adding unnecessary process. Much of what you build doesn't exist yet, so you should be comfortable starting from an ambiguous problem, forming a practical approach, and improving it as you go.

This is an individual-contributor role with broad ownership and global reach. You'll be part of the Engineering & Product Operations team, with a dotted line to the Head of Legal Data, and work closely with Legal Data, Product, Engineering, Growth and Legal across Legora. A legal background is not required.

The role’s key responsibilities are:

  • Support content prioritisation for our digital collection. Build evidence-based recommendations on which jurisdictions, legal sources and data types to prioritise sources, balancing client needs, commercial impact, the competitive and publisher landscape, and delivery feasibility.

  • Turn client demand into strategic insight. Establish a consistent intake process for source and data requests, and combine client conversations, Voice of the Customer insights, inbound partnership opportunities and usage data into actionable recommendations.

  • Build the fact base for investment decisions. Develop business cases for build (e.g., APIs, bulk feeds, scraping of public sources), buy and partner choices.

  • Build and run Legal Data's operating model. Own planning, reporting, systems and tooling; create onboarding processes and playbooks; and coordinate cross-functional projects across Legal Data, Product, Engineering, Growth and Legal to run digital collection operations.

  • Own partner operations from signed agreement to live content. Coordinate handovers and track delivery commitments, reporting obligations, renewals and other contractual requirements.


Who you are

  • Around 3-6 years in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or operations.

  • Highly organised. You manage several workstreams, dependencies and stakeholders without losing the detail or the outcome.

  • Good judgement on when a lightweight process is enough, when more rigour is needed, and when to escalate.

  • A structured, commercial thinker. You can size a market, build a business case and turn messy inputs into a recommendation leadership can act on.

  • Analytically strong and fluent with agentic tools. You use agents to build and maintain systems, trackers and data.

  • A clear, concise communicator who keeps both working teams and senior leadership aligned.

  • You've built practical processes or systems from scratch—not just recommendations—and can show how they improved delivery, visibility or decision-making.

raw.description:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

You'll own the post-sales integration phase for Mollie's largest and most complex deals, taking full responsibility from contract signature through go-live and the handover that follows. That means acting as the central point of contact for the merchant and every internal Mollie team involved, setting out the activities, owners, and timelines needed to get each implementation live.

You'll coordinate closely with sales, sales engineering, onboarding, compliance, product, and other teams to resolve issues as they come up, using your technical understanding to assess merchant problems, work through documentation, and route issues to the right place. You'll keep merchants, digital agencies, and internal stakeholders informed with regular updates, and you'll monitor progress against the agreed go-live date so you can act early when timelines are at risk.

This is a newly formed function that's now expanding into new markets. That means you'll have genuine influence over how the role and its processes take shape, working closely with a flat, collaborative team where good practice is shared regardless of hierarchy.

What you'll ship

  • Own the post sales integration phase for Mollie's largest and most complex deals, from handover through testing to go live

  • Run kickoffs with internal and external stakeholders, setting go live dates and keeping progress on track

  • Organise and track testing, raising issues and feedback as they surface

  • Coordinate across sales, product and engineering colleagues, as well as with merchants directly, to keep everyone aligned

  • Keep agreed go live dates on track, since delays mean missed revenue

  • Maintain documentation and playbooks that make delivery predictable and scalable

What you'll bring

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in implementation, project management, onboarding, delivery, or a similar customer-facing role.

  • Experience in payments, fintech, e-commerce is a plus

  • Proven experience managing complex implementations from contract signature through go-live and handover.

  • Solid understanding of APIs, integrations and technical documentation, with the ability to investigate implementation issues and work with technical teams.

  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, including managing timelines, blockers, dependencies and multiple internal and external stakeholders.

  • Structured, proactive and pragmatic approach, with strong ownership and the confidence to challenge when needed.

  • Excellent communication skills in English

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

 

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

 

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

raw.title: Treasury Manager (ALM)
raw.description:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

Treasury is where Mollie's balance sheet takes shape, this team makes sure that our balance sheet is safe, well-funded and resilient. You, as Treasury Manager, will be one of the first people building the Asset & Liability Management (ALM) function for Mollie.

This is a genuine 0-to-1 role. There is no legacy ALM framework to maintain, no existing ILAAP to update, no established models to inherit. You'll help design and build the liquidity risk framework, the interest rate and credit spread risk approach, and the funding and balance sheet strategy. Your work will feed directly into Mollie’s licence application and, once authorised, into how Mollie actually manages its liquidity and funding risks.

You'll work closely with our product teams, Finance, and Risk Domains and your analysis will be seen by senior leadership and, eventually, by our regulator. As Mollie moves from application to operation, your scope will grow from building the framework to running it.

What you'll ship

  • Build and own the core building blocks of Mollie liquidity risk framework, including the ILAAP, LCR/NSFR monitoring, and liquidity stress testing.

  • Develop Mollie’s approach to interest rate risk and credit spread risk in the banking book (IRRBB/CSRBB), from risk identification through to models, limits and hedging strategy.

  • Contribute to the design of Mollie’s funding and balance sheet strategy, including deposit mix, funding diversification and balance sheet construction.

  • Build the Contingency Funding Plan and related early-warning indicators, so Mollie knows exactly what to do under stress before it needs to.

  • Produce clear, well-documented policies, methodologies and models that will stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors, and Mollie's own second and third lines of defense.

  • Support senior leadership (ALCO or its future equivalent) with the analysis, reporting and recommendations it needs to make sound balance sheet decisions.

  • Partner with Risk, Finance and our external advisors, to make sure Treasury's frameworks are consistent with Mollie’s wider risk appetite and governance.

What you'll bring

  • Around 5+ years of experience in Treasury, ALM or balance sheet risk management, ideally within a bank, though experience in a fintech, PSP or consultancy building similar frameworks is also relevant.

  • Solid working knowledge of liquidity risk (LCR/NSFR, ILAAP) and/or interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB/CSRBB). You don't need to be deep in both, but you understand how they connect to the balance sheet as a whole.

  • Comfort building models and frameworks from a blank page. You're not looking for a well-worn playbook, you're excited to write the first one.

  • Strong quantitative and Excel/financial modelling skills, with the discipline to document your logic clearly enough that someone else, including a regulator, can follow it.

  • The ability to explain complex balance sheet risk topics clearly to non-specialists, and the confidence to defend your recommendations to senior stakeholders.

  • Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of this work that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgment and design.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy.

If you're excited by the idea of building a bank's Treasury function from scratch, for Mollie and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

raw.description:

You’ll own a book of established customers who are scaling quickly and adopting AI in how they work. Your job is to deepen their investment, bring new teams and use cases onto the platform, and become the partner they trust to move faster than their competitors.

We’re early in our growth across the Nordics, so you’ll grow as the region grows. You’ll put your own fingerprints on the territory and access genuine whitespace in a region we’re still building.

This is a quota-carrying role that requires strong sales skills, relationship-building capabilities, and a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences.

About the role

  • The Account Manager position is a growth focused quota-carrying position. You will own the full sales cycle, from generating opportunities and building relationships with key stakeholders through to negotiation, contracting and renewal.

  • Research, identify, and engage opportunities within a territory of accounts with existing spend. Prospect proactively into your accounts (cold calls, emails, social selling, networking, etc.) to build a robust pipeline.

  • Use the value framework and MEDDPICC to run robust deal progression in collaboration with management, advancing and closing opportunities with new use cases.

  • Strategically build relationships within accounts to develop qualified champions. Gain access to Director, VP and C-Level economic buyers so monday.com becomes a strategic partner to our customers, aligned to their corporate goals.

  • Possess a comprehensive understanding of monday.com’s solution and connect this knowledge directly to customer ROI.

  • Work closely with the Customer Success team and other internal stakeholders to create the conditions for account growth. This includes helping customers maximise the value from monday.com and explicitly aligning it to positive business outcomes.

  • Continuously build and refine in-depth knowledge of your target industries, including trends, challenges, key players, and opportunities, to effectively position our solutions and add value to client conversations.

Requirements

  • Experience: 3-5 years of sales experience in a closing role at a SaaS or technology company, with a focus on mid-market accounts.

  • Proven Success: Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas and driving revenue growth. Experience of the Nordics region is preferred.

  • Sales Skills: Strong ability to prospect, qualify, and close deals with mid-sized businesses. Experience with a consultative sales approach.

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts in a clear and relatable manner.

  • Tech-Savvy: Comfortable with technology, with the ability to quickly learn and demonstrate the functionality of software products.

  • CRM Proficiency: Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot for managing sales activities and pipeline.

  • Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues across various teams to achieve shared goals.

  • Builder’s Mindset: Energy for growing something early. You’re comfortable with a territory that isn’t fully mapped and would rather create opportunity than inherit it.

  • Problem Solver: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify business challenges and develop tailored solutions.

  • Customer-Centric: Passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences and adding value to client relationships.

Please note this is a hybrid role with a 3 day per week in the office requirement.

 

What monday.com can offer you:

  • Join a customer-obsessed team where transparency and ownership are how we actually operate - not just things we put on a wall

  • Work on a multi-product suite powered by advanced AI, where what you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide

  • Competitive salary, benefits, bonus potential, and equity eligibility for many roles — we believe people should share in our success

  • Grow fast through a dedicated L&D team, AI workshops, bootcamps, and internal hackathons - the industry moves quick and so do we

  • A collaborative, global culture backed by Employee Resource Groups and workplace teams across New York, Tel Aviv, London, Munich, Warsaw, Tokyo, Sydney, and more

raw.title: Partner GTM Lead, Agentic CRM
raw.description:
monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organisations work and outpace their competition.

About the Role

monday.com is looking for a Go-To-Market Leader to own monday agentic CRM's channel partner strategy across EMEA, based in London. You will take ownership of our go-to-market strategy, focusing on building successful market penetration through a differentiated partner-led motion. This role is ideal for a strategic thinker who is ready to make a regional impact on our channel strategy.

You're a driven leader seeking meaningful achievements in a fast-paced environment. You will report to the Head of Global GTM for monday CRM and work closely with your CRM Partner counterpart in North America. You're a builder who thrives at the intersection of product, GTM, marketing, partnerships, and sales.

You will lead the charge in positioning monday CRM as a competitive player in the CRM space by attracting and activating AI-native implementation partners and other strategic partners. You'll craft partner messaging, own competitive differentiation, and develop sales enablement tools that drive both customer acquisition and expansion.

About monday CRM

With over 50,000 customers in less than three years since launch, monday CRM is the fastest-growing CRM in the world, challenging the top players with a fresh, innovative approach, including a purpose-built agentic workflow layer for modern revenue teams.

What You'll Own

GTM Ownership

  • Develop and execute an end-to-end go-to-market strategy for monday CRM tailored to SMB, mid-market, and enterprise customers across EMEA.

Partner Strategy

  • Design and operationalise a partner program that attracts, enables, and scales strategic alliances with SIs, GSIs, AI-native implementation partners, and DMRs focused on CRM transformation.

Differentiation & Messaging

  • Define and continuously refine our CRM value proposition, messaging framework, and competitive positioning.

  • Articulate monday CRM's agentic capabilities vs. legacy CRM platforms.

Sales & Partner Enablement

  • Build impactful tools including battle cards, objection handling guides, talk tracks, and ROI calculators for internal teams and partners.

Customer Acquisition & Expansion

  • Collaborate with sales, marketing, and partnerships to identify new revenue opportunities, increase win rates, and improve deal velocity.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, and Partnerships to align the product roadmap, campaign strategy, and partner incentives with business goals.

Market Insights

  • Stay on top of EMEA market trends, competitor activity, and customer feedback to inform messaging, product positioning, and strategic decisions.

Requirements

  1. 6-10 years of experience in Business Value, Go-to-Market, Product Marketing, or Partner Strategy roles within B2B SaaS

  2. Deep knowledge of the CRM ecosystem, including AI-native CRM entrants and agentic workflow tooling, and proven experience engaging with SIs and GSIs

  3. EMEA market experience, ideally UK/London-based or with established EMEA partner networks

  4. Strategic thinker with the ability to connect the dots between customer needs, product capabilities, and market opportunities

  5. Strong communicator with a talent for translating complex ideas into clear, compelling narratives

  6. Builder mindset, comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-moving environment

  7. Collaborative leader with a track record of aligning cross-functional teams

  8. Familiarity with AI agent frameworks, prompt-based workflows, or CRM automation at the workflow layer

Candidate Attributes

Need to Have

  • AI fluency, ideally with examples of agentic building

  • GTM background at a sales/marketing tech company, ideally CRM

  • EMEA market experience, ideally UK/London-based or with established EMEA partner networks

Nice to Have

  • Personal brand, visible on LinkedIn, comfortable with building in public

  • Existing relationships with EMEA SIs, GSIs, or CRM-focused agencies


Why monday.com

At monday.com, we're creating the future of work. Join us to build, innovate, and scale a CRM solution that empowers customers and partners to unlock their full potential. If you're ready to own strategy, build from 0 to 1, and make a measurable impact, we'd love to hear from you.
