Director, Business Development - Financial Services
raw.description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry? Are you interested in helping international brands/organizations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!

TransPerfect was founded with a mission to help the world's businesses navigate the global marketplace. Today, we have grown to be an industry leader organization by helping clients globalize their business no matter what service they might need. TransPerfect provides a full array of language and business support services, including translation, subtitling and dubbing, multicultural marketing, website globalization, legal support, and any kind of technology solution.

That’s enough about us – what about you? We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success.

TransPerfect is looking for established sales professionals to further develop our engagement model. The Director of Business Development will be responsible for identifying and engaging with client prospects as well as managing client relationships during the full life cycle of client campaigns. Minimum 3 years experience in a similar role required.

The main focus of the role is to utilise your existing knowledge and experience within the Financial Services sector to develop new business relationships and new accounts via a direct sales approach.

Key position responsibilities:

  • Source and close new clients through referrals, cold calling, networking, and other means (tradeshows, regional organizations, etc.)

  • Build a productive pipeline and manage each phase of the sales process

  • Cultivate and maintain long term relationships with clients by delivering elite client service and engaging them by using knowledge of each industry and organization

  • Formulate sales plan to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets

  • Generate daily outreach efforts (direct mail, digital marketing, cold calls) to prospective clients

  • Develop an effective understanding of the capabilities, benefits, and competitive advantages of TransPerfect's services

  • Present TransPerfect's solutions via one-on-one, group, online and in-person meetings

  • Set and manage client expectations while consulting with each client for best practices

  • Manage and control pricing and contractual issues

  • Travel (including multiple annual conferences, client meetings) - domestic and/or international


Essential skills required:

  • Commit to a high level of integrity and service

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Owning your performance and taking responsibility

  • Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

  • Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

  • Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers

  • Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

  • Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

  • Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

Essential experience required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

  • Minimum 3 years successful sales experience

  • Superior written and spoken communication skills in the local language

  • Familiarity and ability to communicate value and competitive advantages

TransPerfect values equal opportunities. Applicants are therefore considered regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnic origin, skin colour, religion, belief, descent, genes, disabilities, sexual orientation, marital status or other characteristics worthy of protection. Applicants with disabilities are welcome and encouraged. If you experience any issues with your application process or require assistance please contact ----- style="text-align:start;min-height: 1.7em;">

By applying, I confirm I have read and accept TransPerfect's Privacy Policy: https://www.transperfect.com/about/data-privacy-recruiting

raw.title: Junior Account Executive
raw.description:
Sterling Technology, a subsidiary of TransPerfect, is the leading provider of premium virtual data room (VDR) solutions for the secure sharing of content, business process automation, and collaboration for the M&A, corporate development, real estate, capital markets, private capital, banking, and legal communities. Sterling has been supporting the M&A and capital markets for over 30 years, initially with financial printing services. Since opening our first VDR in 2010, we have helped customers from over 187 countries and 90 industries successfully complete thousands of deals. With offices in seven major financial centers, Sterling is trusted by its users to deliver exceptional levels of service on their most critical transactions.

Summary:

The main focus of the role is to enhance clients' relationships and develop new accounts within different industries.

Your responsibilities and tasks will include:

  • Create effective approaches to drive new revenue and close new business

  • Identify, qualify, develop, and close sales opportunities

  • Develop an effective understanding of the capabilities, benefits, and competitive advantages of Sterling’s services

  • Identify prospective leads; develop new client relationships via cold calling, internet research, networking events, and direct marketing

  • Promote Sterling by educating clients on the company’s various services

  • Present Sterling via one-on-one, group, online and in-person meetings

  • Provide customer support and manage client expectations

  • Quote, manage, and bill projects daily, coordinating with clients and production teams to ensure these run smoothly and profitably

  • Communicate professionally at all levels of seniority


Essential skills and experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent

  • Excellent written and verbal proficiency in English

  • Experience and/or interest in sales or a client-facing role

  • Ability to build and maintain long-term client relationships

  • Strong presentation skills (both in-person and online)

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities

  • Highly organised with strong attention to detail

  • Able to prioritise, manage tasks, and work effectively in a team

  • Eager to learn, embrace challenges, and driven to succeed

 

Preferred experience:

  • Experience and/or interest in Financial, Professional, Legal or Technology services

  • Experience and/or interest in the M&A space

  • Experience in a B2B sales/business development role

Sounds like a match? We look forward to meeting you!

raw.title: Regional SEO Team Lead
raw.description:
TransPerfect's Digital department is seeking an experienced Regional SEO Team Lead to own the delivery, growth, and operational excellence of SEO services across a key global region.

This is a senior operational leadership role responsible for the delivery, growth, and operational excellence of all SEO services (Technical & On-Page & AIO/GEO/LLM) within their assigned region (Americas & LATAM OR EMEA & APAC).

The role oversees a regional SEO team, ensuring high-quality delivery within the global SEO frameworks, driving innovation, operational efficiency, and maintaining strong commercial health across client engagements.

Reporting into the Global Director of Digital Strategy, it bridges strategic direction with regional execution ensuring SEO strategies align to global best practices while being adapted for regional needs.

Critically, the Regional SEO Team Lead holds shared responsibility for growing existing client accounts, supporting retention, and achieving defined margin targets, contributing directly to the agency’s profitability and success.


TransPerfect's Digital department is seeking an experienced Regional SEO Team Lead to own the delivery, growth, and operational excellence of SEO services across a key global region.

This is a senior operational leadership role responsible for the delivery, growth, and operational excellence of all SEO services (Technical & On-Page & AIO/GEO/LLM) within their assigned region (Americas & LATAM OR EMEA & APAC).

The role oversees a regional SEO team, ensuring high-quality delivery within the global SEO frameworks, driving innovation, operational efficiency, and maintaining strong commercial health across client engagements.

Reporting into the Global Director of Digital Strategy, it bridges strategic direction with regional execution ensuring SEO strategies align to global best practices while being adapted for regional needs.

Critically, the Regional SEO Team Lead holds shared responsibility for growing existing client accounts, supporting retention, and achieving defined margin targets, contributing directly to the agency’s profitability and success.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Regional SEO Leadership

  • Lead all SEO delivery across Technical SEO, On-Page SEO and AIO/GEO in the assigned region.

  • Ensure all SEO deliverables adhere to global frameworks, SOPs, and quality standards as defined by the Global SEO Team & Global Director of Digital Strategy.

  • Where necessary, collaborate with global/regional counterparts to create and/or maintain global SOPs, ensuring efficiency, consistency and process alignment

  • Oversee regional SEO resourcing (in-house & external), capacity planning, and project prioritization.

Financial & Commercial Accountability

  • Ensure projects/deliverables are executed according to defined metrics and remain in budget.

  • Overseeing time tracking of team members for the accuracy of project markup and provide insights/actions for replicating successes and mitigating in efficiencies

  • Drive SEO account growth within the region, identifying upsell opportunities and supporting pre-sales with scoping, quoting, and proposal support.

  • Maximize internal resource usage while smartly managing vendor outsourcing within approved guidelines for timely SLAs, project completion and revenue recognition.

Operational Management & Team Development

  • Manage and mentor SEO specialists within the region (Tech & On-Page,AIO/GEO), fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture.

  • Ensure a clear training agenda and/or SMART objectives for the development of every team member

  • Ensure clear alignment between Technical SEO, On-Page SEO AIO/GEO, Content, UX/CRO, and Paid Media teams in delivering integrated SEO strategies.

  • Contribute to the evolution of regional outsourcing processes, vendor management, and quality control.

Client Engagement & Collaboration

  • Participate in key client calls (strategy reviews, technical updates, performance reporting) as needed.

  • Support QBRs and strategic reviews alongside Client Services to ensure SEO is contributing to client success and growth.

  • Collaborate closely with the Global Director of Digital Strategy and other Regional SEO Team Leads to share learnings, drive consistency, and evolve services.

Team Integration, Collaboration & Innovation

  • Play a key role in the smooth integration of teams across Technical SEO, On-Page SEO, and supporting functions within the region.

  • Drive alignment on processes, SOPs, and delivery standards — ensuring consistency with global frameworks.

  • Foster an environment of collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation.

  • Act as a champion of AI and GenAI innovation — encouraging the adoption of new tools, automation, and AI-driven processes that enhance delivery, scalability, and performance outcomes.

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

We're looking for someone to supercharge our commercial operations. We're continually scaling our product across new markets and new clients, and we want to go even faster.

This is a wide-ranging role that'll require you to move at speed across diverse topics; in return, you'll gain high levels of ownership and exposure. Example topics include:

  • ﻿﻿Entering new markets, from research & analysis to planning & delivery

  • ﻿﻿Helping our new and existing clients get the most out of our software

What's in it for you

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity).

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

raw.description:
Introduction to Role & Team

Bumble Inc. is looking for an Operations Specialist, AI Enablement to join our CX & Trust team. Trust, care, and high-quality experiences are central to Bumble’s mission to create a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable, and in this role you’ll help bring that mission to life by improving how our AI-powered customer experience and moderation systems support our community.

You’ll evaluate AI-powered customer interactions and automated moderation decisions against Bumble’s policies, processes, and quality standards, helping us understand where our systems are performing well and where they can improve. Through quality reviews, accurate case labelling, golden-set maintenance, and thoughtful analysis, you’ll help ensure AI-supported decisions are consistent, precise, and grounded in the nuance required to serve our members responsibly. You’ll work closely with the AI Performance & Enablement Manager and colleagues across CX & Trust, taking ownership of high-quality work and demonstrating our Bumble values of Courage, Curiosity, Respect, and Excellence as we reimagine how AI can strengthen trust and care across the member experience.

This role will be based in London and will work in a hybrid model.

What you’ll do

  • Conduct quality reviews of AI-powered customer conversations and automated moderation decisions, assessing their alignment with Bumble’s community policies, operational processes, and quality standards.

  • Analyse policy enforcement gaps and nuanced cases, identifying where automated decisions may be inconsistent, unclear, or misaligned with policy intent and surfacing actionable insights for improvement.

  • Perform accurate case labelling to support AI model training, evaluation pipelines, and ongoing quality benchmarking, demonstrating Excellence through careful and consistent application of established guidance.

  • Review and maintain golden sets that reflect current policy standards and provide reliable ground truth for assessing AI quality, accuracy, and precision.

  • Report quality issues through established workflows, taking ownership of accurate categorisation, clear documentation, and actionable feedback, and seeing insights through to meaningful impact.

  • Collaborate purposefully with the AI Performance & Enablement Manager on scoring consistency, calibration, recurring quality issues, and opportunities to strengthen AI reliability and the member experience.

  • Identify patterns and share learnings that can improve AI accuracy and precision, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency, approaching emerging challenges with Curiosity and an agile mindset.

  • Use QA platforms and AI-supported tools, including systems such as Cinder, Zendesk QA, and Bumble’s internal assessment tooling, to monitor quality and understand AI behaviour, reviewing outputs critically for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness and applying human judgment before acting on results.

About you

  • Requires 1+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

  • Bring experience or transferable skills from Trust & Safety, content moderation, Customer Experience, quality assurance, or another fast-paced, policy-driven environment.

  • Have a sharp eye for detail and can objectively evaluate conversations, moderation decisions, and other interactions against established policies, processes, and quality standards.

  • Bring familiarity with conversational AI systems, chatbots, automated moderation, or AI-supported workflows, with the Curiosity to continue learning how these systems behave, where their limitations lie, and how human judgment can improve their effectiveness.

  • Understand, or are motivated to learn, quality assurance practices such as case labelling, calibration, consistent scoring, golden-set evaluation, and clear documentation of quality findings.

  • Are comfortable learning digital tools and platforms and can use data and quality insights to identify meaningful patterns while adapting your approach as systems, policies, and priorities evolve.

  • Collaborate purposefully with colleagues, take ownership of your deliverables, and see work through from insight to impact while welcoming feedback as an opportunity to learn and improve.

  • Apply AI thoughtfully and responsibly, assessing outputs for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness rather than relying on them without review, and demonstrate Bumble’s values of Respect, Curiosity, and Excellence in how you support our community and colleagues.

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI Fluency

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.

Final Compensation

Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations.

Inclusion at Bumble Inc.

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc).

AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring

At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly.

Fraudulent Candidate Detection

Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review

For further information on how we hold and manage your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

Company Overview

At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.

The Role

As Senior Product Manager, Software Delivery, you will sit at the handoff point between ideas and engineering — taking a raw idea or ask and shaping it into a well-formed request the software team can build against. You own the what: defining the problem, scope, and acceptance criteria behind every request. Working alongside the Project Manager, who runs sprints and day-to-day delivery mechanics, you'll advocate for how requests should be sequenced and when they should land, making sure priority calls reflect the needs behind the work rather than just what's next in the queue.

At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day.

Responsibilities:

  • Turn ideas into formal requests: work with the Product Lead and other stakeholders to take a defined ask and translate it into a clear, engineering-ready ticket — problem statement, scope, acceptance criteria, and any relevant regulatory or clinical context — before it enters the backlog.

  • Own and prioritise the software ticket pipeline in Jira: intake, triage, and grooming, so the backlog reflects real, current priority rather than the order things happened to arrive in.

  • Own the idea-to-documentation handoff with the software team — making sure every piece of work that reaches engineering has the context, requirements, and supporting documentation it needs in Confluence, and that decisions made along the way are captured rather than lost in Slack.

  • Advocate for how and when work should happen: partner with the Project Manager, who owns sprint planning and delivery mechanics, to make sure sequencing and timing reflect genuine priority rather than convenience.

  • Keep the software pipeline's information in the right place — Jira for delivery, Confluence for documentation — rather than in slide decks or side channels, and help extend that operating model as the team grows.

Skills & Experience:

  • Experience as a Product Manager, Technical Product Manager, or Product Owner working directly with a software engineering team, ideally in a regulated or safety-conscious environment.

  • Comfort writing requirements and acceptance criteria precise enough for engineers to build against without repeated back-and-forth.

  • A natural translator: equally comfortable in a conversation with a non-technical stakeholder describing a problem and in a ticket-grooming session with engineers debating implementation trade-offs.

  • Comfortable in an early-stage environment where requests arrive informally and priorities shift, and where part of the job is imposing structure rather than just following it.

  • Drawn to the operational side of product management — energised by getting the machinery of idea-to-delivery running smoothly, not just by defining the vision.

  • Nice to have: experience in medical devices or another regulated hardware/software environment, with exposure to documentation practices under ISO 13485 or IEC 62304.

  • Nice to have: prior experience setting up or overhauling a ticket intake and triage process from scratch, rather than inheriting one.

  • Private medical, dental and vision insurance (medical history disregarded)

  • Group life insurance at 4x annual income

  • Comprehensive mental health support, including unlimited access to 1:1 sessions with trained professionals

WHY CONDUCT

We believe the world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the decade-old systems they run on. Today they don't.

Every process change, every new product line runs into software systems layered with decades of custom code and complexity no human mind can fully comprehend. New requirements take months to ship, system migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain.

We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed and ambition. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

You'll work side by side with our three founders as they tackle one of the most complex problems of our generation. Their time is one of the most valuable things we have, and you'll help to decide how it gets spent. One day that means getting a CEO to a customer in Germany. The next, it's prepping a board meeting or landing a candidate we've been chasing for months. Plans often change hourly and you'll help keep everything on track. You'll be our first EA, so you'll set the standard for how we support the founders. As we grow, the team around you might too, and you'll help shape how it works. Few roles give you this view of how a generational company gets built, and as we scale, your scope grows with us.

In practice:

  • Help run packed founder calendars and decide what they spend their time on

  • Set up the meetings that move Conduct forward, with enterprise customers, investors and partners, and make sure everyone walks in prepared and walks out with next steps

  • Write on the founders' behalf to customers, investors and partners, and get every detail right

  • Keep board and investor meetings running smoothly, from scheduling to follow-ups

  • Help candidates have a great first experience of Conduct

WHO WE HIRE

You're the person everyone goes to when something needs to get done properly. You might already be an EA, or you might be in a role where you've quietly been doing the job of one.

  • You thrive when things are messy and moving fast, and you bring structure without waiting to be asked

  • You're smart and proactive, and you see what's needed before anyone asks

  • You're happy to push back, even with a founder, when something doesn't need to happen

  • You communicate clearly and confidently, in writing and in person, whether it's an investor, a customer or a new hire

  • You have a zero-error mindset: anything with your name or a founder's on it is right first time, even on the busiest days

raw.title: Founding Design Engineer
raw.description:
Cypress

Running a business today means operating in one world and understanding in another. The owner lives in a stream of real-world events — deliveries, staffing, inventory, customers — context-switching into spreadsheets, dashboards, and reports to make sense of the data. These two realities never quite line up. Cypress collapses the distance between business reality and understanding.

We are building a generational company to enable the future of ownership. Our platform continuously models a business as it runs, constructing a living representation that agents can act on and owners can collaborate with. The result is something that hasn't existed before: businesses that understand themselves. This changes who can own a business, how those businesses are operated, and how far they can go.

Cypress Labs is backed by top-tier venture capital and a roster of angel investors with operational expertise. Founded by Spencer Wilson (MIT, Marshall Scholar, UCL neuroscience PhD, previously Ctrl-Labs and Trisk Bio) and Josh Hone (first commercial hire at bootstrapped Quorum, COO at venture-backed Column).

We're working in person in London.

The Role

An extraordinary designer is one of our first hires because design is central to the problem we're solving. You will own the entire surface area of how owners interact with our system: the grammar of interaction, the visual language, and the code that brings it to life.

Your work sits at the boundary of product, research, and infrastructure. You will transform dense event streams and simulations into views that are beautiful, clear, and immediately useful to busy people running real businesses in the physical world.

What You Will Do

  • Define the visual language and patterns of interaction for an AI-native product from square one

  • Design and build owner-facing views that make complex business operations legible and actionable

  • Create the information design layer between our intelligence engine and the owners it serves

  • Ship production code in a modern frontend stack

  • Establish the taste bar for everything the user touches

You Bring

  • Significant product design experience at organizations where craft and tempo are taken seriously. You know what excellence looks like, your bar is high. NB: we are open to a broad range of experience levels if your work speaks for itself and we see clear indications of high learning rate.

  • A portfolio that reveals clear thinking about the underlying problem, not just beautifully arranged pixels.

  • Fluency shipping in a modern frontend stack, and a desire to learn new technologies as needed.

  • Systems thinking. You reason about state, sequence, and context, not just layout.

  • Genuine interest in how AI rewrites the rules of interfaces.

  • High agency. You identify the right problem, propose a direction, and build it.

Why Us

  • Design engineers almost never get founding-team equity. Most join after the product language is already written. Cypress is an opportunity to invent new modes of interaction for intelligent systems before the conventions are set.

  • Our team will stay small, and our ambitions will stay big. We aim for a high revenue-to-headcount ratio and a high-trust, high-ownership culture.

  • Both co-founders are strong writers and thought partners who care deeply about design and about our customers. What we need is the ability to rapidly execute and iterate on visual design at the level our products demand. You'll be the key creative partner we're building with.

  • Backed by a top-tier venture firm and an angel roster of experienced operators. Product is already working with early design partners.

Compensation

£100k to £155k base, depending on experience. Meaningful equity reflecting a founding role.

Apply

Apply through Ashby with a resume and portfolio.

raw.title: Senior Manager
raw.description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

 

About the team


Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

 

About the role

 

As a Senior Manager within our Public Services team, you’ll lead critical work for discerning and highly AI literate customers in the UK Government and for international partners. This is a fast paced and demanding role which, in addition to mission area context, requires programme delivery mastery and an ability to think thoughtfully and creatively about the role for AI in the core public services we utilise on a daily basis.

 

You can expect to lead portfolios of work for our customers, which range from experimental applications of emerging technologies, to products that we progress through a complete development lifecycle and deploy for users in Government.

 

What you'll be doing:

 

  • Managing the delivery of multiple, complex programmes of work for our Public Services clients including strategy, R&D, and product builds.

  • Overseeing a portfolio of projects across multiple facets of the Public Services including the Home Office, Department for Education and others.

  • Developing and owning compelling proposals to grow our Public Sector portfolio.

  • Mentoring and developing team members, aligning their responsibilities with the critically important Public Services work for which we’re responsible.

  • Working strategically to deliver meaningful outcomes for public sector organisations rather than just focusing on outputs.

  • Forming strong, trusted relationships with senior government customers and collaborating closely with other consulting partners where needed

  • Advising clients on AI strategy and technical implementation, engaging confidently in technical discussions with directors.

  • Supporting wider business efforts as a Senior Manager to ensure maximum strategic flexibility and commercial impact.

     

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You are an experienced Senior Manager with a strong background in managing complex, large-scale transformation programs.

  • You bring proven experience in Public Services space, possibly from your time in Government, academia, or roles in industry.

  • You have a track recored of shipping GDS-style digital products and knowing exactly what it takes to get AI-enabled services over the line in Government.

  • You have a demonstrable interest and understanding of AI and ML concepts and can think creatively about their application for a range of Public Sector challenges.

  • You possess the technical nous to engage confidently with directors on engineering concepts and AI applications.

  • You understand the commercial consulting delivery model, allowing you to focus immediately on account growth and project oversight.

  • You possess the flexibility to support broader Senior Manager work and embrace an entrepreneurial approach to a highly visible portfolio.

  • You thrive in ambiguous settings and demonstrate a structured approach to problem-solving and delivering high-quality, high-stakes projects.

 

The Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the team (60 minutes)

  3. Case Study Interview (60 minutes)

  4. Culture and Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

 

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

raw.title: Director of Deployment
raw.description:
At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?

About the role

We're looking for a Director of Deployment to lead our Solutions team, the engineers who get our product live in industrial customers' plants, and to make every deployment faster, better and more reliable than the last.

You'll be accountable for every deployment we run, and be the senior escalation route, for our team and our customers, when something gets stuck.

This is a new role, and a leadership role, but a hands-on one. You'll coach our solutions engineers and leaders as they own deployments and customer relationships themselves, and step in yourself when a plant needs it. You'll work with Product, Machine Learning and Engineering to decide what goes back into the core product, so every plant is faster than the last.

What will this role achieve?

The goal: Take Gigaton from 9 plants live to 50 by the end of 2027, with every new plant going from signed contract to the end of evaluation in 8 weeks.

Outcome – 50 plants live. You've taken us from 9 plants to 50 by 31 December 2027, across our customers worldwide. You've planned how many engineers we need and which teams new joiners go into, tracked the health of the whole portfolio every week, and stepped in early when a deployment started to drift.

Outcome – 8 weeks from contract to results. Today a plant takes about six months to reach evaluation. You've cut that to 8 weeks end to end, and published the numbers that prove it. You've done it by turning repeated human work and customer-specific work into product, built with Product and Engineering. Each plant now needs half the people it did when you joined.

Outcome – a grip on results. Before we start, every plant has agreed with us what success looks like and whose data counts. You've balanced the need to hit our timelines with the need to pass evaluations, pausing a plant that isn't ready rather than letting it fail, so every evaluation has passed first time. When something has gone wrong, you've found the root cause fast and fixed it, so we only make each mistake once.

Outcome – a team of superstars that keeps growing. You've designed the team that delivers 50 plants and grown it to the size your design needs, hiring people who raise our bar. You've coached it actively: your leaders run high-performing teams, every engineer is autonomous, happy and smashing it for our customers, and everyone in Solutions can name what they've got better at because of you. We haven't lost anyone we wanted to keep.

Outcome – customers who trust us at every level. Every plant has a clear owner, and an escalation route that solves problems before they reach our exec team. You've built a clean handover from Sales and a voice for Deployment in which plants we take on.

Outcome – post-sales solved. With our sales leader, you've set up how we run every plant after evaluation, and it works, with clear responsibilities mapped out. Model upkeep, support and retraining are handled. Expansion contracts and upsells run through the same model: each one has a clear owner, and we spot opportunities before the customer raises them.

What a great fit looks like

  • You have deployed early AI product into business customers, hands-on and alongside engineers. You worked out what would create value and decided what was worth building. Not onboarding customers onto a product that was already finished.

  • You have turned bespoke work into repeatable product. You decided which customer-specific features and fixes belonged in the core product, and you can show the numbers: deployments that got faster, with fewer people, while volume grew.

  • You have earned the trust of customer leaders, from site head up to executive level, been their escalation point and unblocked hard problems. You're credible because you've built and shipped.

  • You have grown a delivery team and made the decisions that came with it, including hiring and performance management. You've designed the team's structure as it grew.

  • You're a coach who was recently a quarterback. You can still step in, but you know you'll have more impact by building a team that doesn't need you to.

  • You agree what success means with a customer before you start, and you prove it with numbers.

  • You notice early signs of trouble and raise them with urgency, and you use judgement to tell what needs action and what doesn't.

  • You're happy to travel to our plants worldwide, about a quarter of the time and more in your first few months: to build relationships with customer leaders, coach your team on site and learn how our plants run.

You'll excel if

  • You have managed managers, or grown an engineer into a team lead.

  • You have worked in a forward-deployed or deployment strategist model, where small teams embed with customers.

  • You have set up post-sales or account management for a B2B product.

  • You have deployed software into physical operations: plants, factories, utilities, energy assets or similar.

  • You care about decarbonising energy intensive industries.

Details

  • Reports to: Noah Miller, COO

  • Team: our Solutions team of solutions engineers and two team leads, which you'll lead and grow

  • Location: London, at least 2 days a week in the office, with about 25% travel to customer plants

  • Visa sponsorship: available if required

💡 You are not expected to check every box, and we’d love to hear from you even if your experience isn’t an exact match.

We’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Our people come from different countries, cultures and experiences, and we think that’s one of our biggest strengths.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected and celebrated. No matter your background, if you’re excited by what we do, we want to hear from you.

The interview process - subject to change

We aim to go from first call to offer in three weeks.

  1. First call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

  2. Interview with Noah, our COO, walking through your career (60 minutes)

  3. Work sample day. We share real data from one of our plants. You spend 30 minutes with two of our team leads, then present how you'd run the deployment and how you'd shape the team for 50 plants. This includes a conversation about how you lead people. We'll give you the background you need beforehand.

  4. Operating Principles interview with a panel from across Gigaton

  5. Final interview with Josh, our CEO

  6. References, then an offer

We believe hiring is a two-way process. Just as we’ll reference-check candidates before making a final offer, we encourage you to reference-check us by chatting to team members you haven’t yet met. Ask anything. We’ll answer with Concrete Honesty.

Once interviews are done, we’ll move quickly to a decision, and we’re always happy to give feedback at any stage.

In return for your hard work, we’ll give you

📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside.

🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team.

🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge

🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one.

Our Operating Principles

The work itself will shift from being very in-the-weeds, very heavily admin-focused to deeply strategic, depending on where the blockers are.

This is one of the highest-leverage roles in the company. You will have more context, responsibility and impact than people with far more senior titles at larger companies.

  • We're about to walk into a meeting with a manufacturer in a new industry (chemicals, steel, ammonia). You make sure we arrive briefed, with impeccable materials, and that we follow up effectively.

About Ledger

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

The team:

Ledger has secured digital assets for millions of people. Ledger Enterprise brings the same security to institutions. Banks, exchanges, custodians and stablecoin issuers use our platform to hold, move and govern digital assets on infrastructure they control: Vault for self-custody, HSM On-Premises for institutions that need keys inside their own perimeter, TradeLink for off-exchange settlement, and Multisig for on-chain governance.

You’ll work closely with Business Development, Solutions Engineering, Product, Legal and Support, covering clients across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. Join a young, international, driven team in one of Ledger’s fastest-growing areas.

What you’ll be doing:

You will own a portfolio of institutional clients from signature onward. That covers onboarding, integration, adoption, renewal and expansion. You will be their trusted advisor inside Ledger and their voice in our product roadmap.

  • Own client relationships end to end. Be the primary contact for a portfolio of exchanges, banks, custodians and fintechs, and build relationships from operations teams up to C-level.

  • Drive integration and adoption. Explain product features clearly, run workshops, and guide clients through technical integration together with our Solutions Engineers.

  • Grow accounts. Identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities such as new products, additional users, assets or entities. Own your expansion and retention targets.

  • Negotiate renewals and contracts. Lead commercial discussions on renewals, amendments and pricing, working with Legal on terms.

  • Shape the product. Turn client feedback into clear, prioritised input for Product and influence what we build next.

  • Run the account rhythm. Lead QBRs, maintain account plans, keep the CRM accurate, and flag risks early.

  • Represent Ledger. Meet clients on-site and at industry events across EMEA, with occasional travel.

What we’re looking for:

  • 4+ years in a similar account management or customer success role, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise infrastructure software.

  • Proven experience managing financial institution clients such as banks, asset managers, custodians or payment providers.

  • A track record of upselling and expanding accounts against targets.

  • Experience negotiating contracts and renewals with enterprise clients.

  • Comfort with technical conversations: you can explain APIs, integration flows and security concepts without needing an engineer in every meeting.

  • Hands-on experience with digital assets, or a clear and demonstrable interest in the space.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English. You can adapt your message for a CISO, a head of operations or a CFO.

  • A structured, self-driven way of working. You manage a portfolio without being chased.

Nice to have:

  • Understanding of regulatory frameworks relevant to EMEA clients, such as MiCAR, DORA, the Travel Rule, the Basel crypto-asset standards, FINMA requirements, or Middle East regimes like VARA (Dubai) and ADGM.

  • Familiarity with custody and key management concepts like MPC, HSMs and cold/warm/hot wallet setups.

  • Additional languages, especially German, French or Arabic.

  • Experience at a crypto-native firm, a bank’s digital asset desk or a custody provider.

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

  • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

  • Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

About the team

This role owns a varied portfolio, including specialist credit hire claims such as taxi and motorbike hire, ensuring that liability and indemnity is investigated, setting accurate reserves and negotiating settlement.

It supports our goals around fair, efficient claims outcomes and strong loss-ratio performance.

What you'll be doing

  • Manage a portfolio of Third Party Property Damage (TPPD) and Credit Hire claims, progressing them efficiently in line with our processes.

  • Handle credit hire claims across specialist vehicle types, including taxi and motorbike hire, applying the correct rates, hire periods and agreements.

  • Triage and manage inbound communications effectively, routing work to support timely claim resolution.

  • Investigate claims and assess liability and indemnity with policyholders, witnesses and third parties to identify recovery opportunities and make sound decisions.

  • Keep policyholders informed with clear, empathetic communication throughout their claim journey.

  • Set and maintain claim reserves and process payments in line with our reserving approach.

  • Detailed notes left on the claims system, explaining action, trail of through and next steps.

  • Accurate reserve setting on files to reflected expected payouts.

  • Housekeeping to ensure accuracy on our claims system.

  • Professional communication either with the customer or the third party representatives.

We offer a flexible hybrid work model, with the team coming together at our London office once every two weeks.

Your expertise

  • Hands-on experience managing Credit Hire and Third Party Property Damage (TPPD) claims, including challenging hire periods, rates, and credit hire agreements.

  • Experience handling credit hire claims across specialist vehicle types, including taxi and motorbike hire.

  • Confidence in negotiating settlements over the phone and email.

  • Solid grasp of relevant case law and when to apply it, and confidence discussing liability and indemnity decisions.

  • Comfortable setting and maintaining reserves and processing payments within agreed authority levels, with a track record of sound, independent decision-making.

  • Used to managing a varied caseload at pace, prioritising effectively and keeping claimants and third parties informed throughout.

Who you are

  • You balance commercial judgement with a customer-focused approach.

  • You make decisions confidently and know when to escalate for another view.

  • You stay organised and prioritise well when managing multiple cases at pace.

  • You look for better ways of working and support wider team goals, not just your own caseload.

Perks & benefits

  • Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance

  • Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva

  • Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year

  • Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

Our process

  1. Initial call with a member of our Talent Acquisition team.

  2. Interview with two members of the Claims team.

We review every application and will always let you know the outcome, though we're unable to provide individual feedback at application stage.

#LI-PT1

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

raw.description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

Why this role exists

Multiverse builds AI products for the future of work, and we want our own People team to run on the same principles we sell to customers. This role is about building an AI-native People function from the ground up, with someone who thinks in systems: workflows, guardrails, tasks and constraints, rather than one-off fixes. We care more about how you learn and build than how many years you've clocked up. If you've built something you can show us, whether that's a tool, a process, or a system that scaled, bring it. That's a bigger part of the interview than a standard work history.

What you'll actually do

A People Product Lead bridges People strategy with hands-on technical product management. You will build scalable foundations for internal operations such as core HR systems, automation, access, and data flows supporting ~1000 employees across the lifecycle

  • Define the long-term vision, strategy, and quarterly roadmap for internal People Ops technology and platforms including success measures for the domain.

  • Build scalable foundations across People systems that support the employee lifecycle, from core People platforms to integrations, data flows, identity and automation.

  • Make high-quality trade-offs across build, buy and integrate decisions, balancing user experience, scalability, reliability, security and compliance.

  • Lead through influence by aligning senior stakeholders across People, Engineering, Security, Compliance, Legal, Analytics and Operations.

  • Improve productivity and reduce friction for Multiverse employees by simplifying processes and creating intuitive, reliable technology experiences.

  • Drive measurable impact by defining KPIs, learning from delivery and continuously improving how the domain operates.

You will be successful if…

  • You have 5+ years working in HR, in technology, analytics, or operations

  • You think in systems: workflows, guardrails, constraints, and how the parts fit together

  • You have a strong track record of learning fast and applying it

  • You've built something real you can walk us through: a tool, a process, or a system you scaled

This role won’t work for you if…

  • You're uncomfortable working with technology and automation

  • You prefer high-touch, service-led processes over product-led ways of working

Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

  • Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

  • Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy, our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).

For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings.

Providing false information is an offence and could result in the application being rejected or summary dismissal if the applicant has been selected, and possible referral to the police and the DBS.

Who we are

Resonance is an Applied AI company, founded by a team of seasoned operators and engineers from Europe's leading software investor and a leading AI consultancy. Collectively we've shipped 30+ AI products, embedded AI into 50+ businesses and created $250m of value for them.

AI models are improving faster than companies can use them. The models are good enough today. What's missing is building AI into how a company actually works, and that's what we do. We work with ambitious companies to help fundamentally rewire how they work with AI, and accelerate their growth.

Our mission is to help companies reinvent themselves for the AI era and cross the emerging AI productivity gap.

The role

We are looking for graduates to join Resonance's first graduate cohort in London. You will work on client projects from your first month, alongside senior engineers and transformation leads, turning redesigned processes into AI running in production.

You'll join one of two tracks. Tell us which interests you when you apply; if you're not sure, we'll work it out together during the process.

  • Applied AI Engineer: build and ship production AI systems for clients, including agents, integrations, data pipelines and evals, and help build our own AI products and platform

  • AI Transformation Lead: map how a client's key processes really run, find where AI changes the economics, build the business case and prototype new workflows with the latest AI tools

What you'll do

Work on real client projects

  • Join a client team from your first month and own pieces of work from day one

  • Sit with the people who do the work today and see how AI changes it

Build and test

  • Build with the latest AI models and tools, whether that's production code or prototype workflows

  • Track what each build delivers once it goes live, and help client teams run and extend it

Grow at pace

  • Coaching from senior engineers, transformation leads and the founding team

  • Take on more ownership as you grow, and help shape our company as a key member of our team

Your first year

  • Training: Comprehensive training when you join, covering AI, your track's craft, how we run client projects and the industries we work in

  • Your first project: On a client team from your first month, with a senior engineer or transformation lead who coaches you

  • Progression: You'll start as a Junior Engineer or Junior Transformation Lead and typically move up a level within 18–24 months

How we work

  • A small team: You'll know everyone by name, founders included

  • Questions welcome: Nobody expects you to know it all when you start. Asking for help early is part of the job, and senior people make time for it

  • Low ego, high standards: We set a high bar and help each other reach it. Credit is shared, and mistakes are something we learn from together

  • Time together: Three days a week in the office means you learn by working next to people, not just over video calls

Who you are

Mindset

  • You take the initiative: you start things without being asked and see them through

  • You're obsessed with AI and try new models and tools the day they come out

  • New problems and new domains give you energy, and you like solving them with other people

  • You learn fast and go looking for hard problems

Background

  • You're finishing a degree or have already completed one

  • You likely studied Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or another technical or quantitative subject

  • You can show what you're capable of through your grades, competitions, internships, societies or things you've built

AI fluency

  • You use AI every day and have built something with it: a workflow, an agent, a tool or a project

For the engineering track

  • You write good code in Python or TypeScript

For the transformation track

  • You structure complex problems quickly and back your arguments with data

Nice to have

raw.title: Junior Machine Learning Engineer
raw.description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing Machine Learning and AI at Trainline 👋 

Machine learning is at the heart of Trainline's mission to help millions of people make sustainable travel choices every day. Our ML models power critical aspects of our platform, including: 

  • Advanced search and recommendations capabilities across our mobile and web applications 

  • Pricing and routing optimisations to find the best fares for customers 

  • Personalised user experiences enhanced by Reinforced Learning Agents & Generative AI 

  • Data-driven digital marketing systems 

  • AI agents improving customer support 

Our machine learning teams own the complete delivery lifecycle from ideation to production. We work closely with stakeholders across the business to expand the understanding and impact of machine learning and AI throughout Trainline. 

The Role:

We are looking for a Junior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team help shape the future of train travel. You will be part of a highly innovative AI and ML platform working alongside engineers, scientists and product managers to tackle complex challenges by combining Trainline’s rich datasets with cutting edge algorithms. What unites our team is an expertise in the field, a love of what we do and the desire to create impactful solutions to support Trainline’s goals of encouraging sustainable travel.  

As a part of Trainline you will be joining an environment where learning and development is top priority. You will have the opportunity to work with fellow ML enthusiasts on large-scale production systems, delivering highly impactful products that make a difference to our millions of users.  

As a Junior Machine Learning Engineer at Trainline you will... 🚄   

  • Work in cross-functional teams combining data scientists, software, data and machine learning engineers, and product managers  

  • Design and deliver machine learning models at scale that drive measurable impact for our business  

  • Own the full end to end machine learning delivery lifecycle including data exploration, feature engineering, model selection and tuning, offline and online evaluation, deployments and maintenance  

  • Work with MLE Team and Stakeholders to help design and deliver data driven products using Trainline's extensive datasets and modern machine learning techniques

  • Create the tools, frameworks and libraries that enables the acceleration of our ML products delivery and improve our workflows  

  • Take an active part in our AI and ML community and foster a culture of rigorous learning and experimentation 

We'd love to hear from you if you...🔍   

  • Have an advanced degree in Computer Science, Mathematics or a similar quantitative discipline  

  • Are proficient with Python, including open-source data libraries (e.g Pandas, Numpy, Scikit learn etc.)    

  • Have experience productionising machine learning models   

  • Are an expert in one of predictive modeling, classification, regression, optimisation or recommendation systems  

  • Have experience with Spark   

  • Have knowledge of DevOps technologies such as Docker and Terraform and ML Ops practices and platforms like ML Flow  

  • Have experience with agile delivery methodologies and CI/CD processes and tools  

  • Have a broad of understanding of data extraction, data manipulation and feature engineering techniques   

  • Are familiar with statistical methodologies.  

  • Have good communication skills   

Nice to have 😍 

  • Understanding and/or hands-on experience of Reinforcement Learning theories, frameworks, and algorithms

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure  

  • Experience with Large Language Models (fine tuning, RAG, agents)

  • Experience with graph technology and/or algorithms, understanding of NLP algorithms

Our technology stack 💻  

  • Python and associated ML/DS libraries (scikit-learn, NumPy, LightGBM, Pandas, TensorFlow, etc...) 

  • PySpark 

  • AWS cloud infrastructure: EMR, ECS, Athena, etc.  

  • MLOp/DevOps: Terraform, Docker, Airflow, MLFlow, NewRelic  

The interview process 🚉 

  • Recruiter Call (30 minutes)

  • Meeting a Machine Learning Manager (30 minutes)

  • Technical Interview with 2 x Engineers (90 mins)

  • Final Interview with the Head of (30-45 mins)

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail

Unity Advisory is a modern advisory business built for today's CFO, with connected solutions across finance, deals and tax. Focussed on client outcomes, seasoned experts lead every engagement, in an operating model powered by AI and free from audit conflict.

The Role

We're building out our capital allowances offering and are looking for a Senior Manager to help lead its delivery and growth. You'll take ownership of a portfolio of clients across sectors, leading complex engagements from individual property acquisitions through to major construction programmes and multi-site capital expenditure reviews.

Working closely with our capital allowances lead, you'll advise senior finance teams, oversee technical quality and commercial performance, develop colleagues and win new work. You'll also work with our Tax, Deals and Office of the CFO teams to identify opportunities across Unity.

You'll help shape how the practice operates, including how we use technology and AI to improve claim preparation, data analysis and client reporting. Your technical judgement and client relationships will remain central to the work.

Responsibilities

Lead capital allowances engagements from scoping and proposals through to delivery, taking responsibility for budgets, resources, deadlines and profitability.

Build and manage senior client relationships, providing practical advice on capital expenditure and the cash tax benefits of available reliefs.

Oversee the preparation and review of capital allowances claims and technical reports, resolving complex issues and maintaining high standards of quality and compliance.

Advise on plant and machinery allowances, structures and buildings allowances, land remediation relief and the tax treatment of fixed assets.

Support property acquisitions, disposals and wider transactions, including due diligence, expenditure apportionments and capital allowances elections.

Analyse fixed asset registers, construction cost information and supporting documentation, working with clients, surveyors and other advisers to identify qualifying expenditure.

Lead HMRC correspondence and enquiries, supporting technical positions and negotiating on behalf of clients where required.

Develop new business through proposals, pitches, external relationships and opportunities within existing client accounts, working alongside colleagues across Unity.

Improve delivery methods through automation, analytics and AI, maintaining appropriate technical review and handling client data responsibly.

Significant experience in UK capital allowances or fixed asset tax advisory, with a track record of leading complex engagements and managing a client portfolio.

Strong technical knowledge of UK capital allowances legislation, with experience advising on property transactions and major capital expenditure projects.

CTA, ACA, ACCA, RICS or an equivalent relevant qualification.

Experience interpreting financial data, construction costs and technical documentation to support robust claims.

Commercial judgement, including managing engagement profitability and contributing to winning new work.

Experience managing and developing colleagues, with confidence reviewing work and resolving technical issues.

An adaptable, collaborative approach and an appetite to help build a growing practice.
